---
| | ,

**No one said taking down corrupt Ken Paxton would be easy.**

I've been at it for almost two years now — traveling all across our great state, meeting Texans, and listening to their concerns about the state of our Attorney General's office.

Over the course of our effort, **we've held hundreds of events in over 100 counties**. We've **reached millions of Texan voters** through online video, direct mail, text messaging, and block walking. And **we've won high-profile endorsements** that prove that we are the campaign prepared to win in November. As a third generation Texas trial lawyer, a grandson of the legendary Watergate Special Prosecutor Leon Jaworski, a former mayor of Galveston, Texas and an international mediator who resolves difficult disputes five days a week, **I am capable, tested and ready for this job on Day One.** I intend to fulfill the consequential duties of office with a public servant’s heart, just as when I was mayor of Galveston, TX following Hurricane Ike, and just as I have done for over thirty years in Texas state and federal courts serving large and small businesses, community institutions and people in all walks of life.

**Integrity, experience, and the rule of law will win this election.**

That's why I'm asking for your vote in the Texas Democratic Primary Runoff Election on May 24.

We must work together if we are going to defeat Ken Paxton and finally turn Texas blue.
[](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=7b17b6d063&e=5d8d80652b)
**Early voting starts today and continues through May 20.** [**Find your polling location here.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=66d1349d54&e=5d8d80652b)

We're all in this together. I'm asking for your vote in this election.

Thank you for your support and know one thing — I will always do what's right for Texas.

Onward,

Joe

body:
We’re reaching out because we urgently need your help before we get our Republican opponent tomorrow.
#

We’re reaching out because we urgently need your help before we get our Republican opponent tomorrow.
Here’s the deal: We could be facing failed former Governor Pat McCrory who signed HB2 into law — costing North Carolina billions and harming our LGBTQ+ communities. Or it could be DC insider Rep. Ted Budd, who Trump endorsed in return for rubber-stamping his far-right agenda including voting to overturn the 2020 election.
Either of these guys would be bad news for North Carolina and our democracy, but together, we can make sure they don’t get anywhere close to the Senate.
Three different polls — including one released just last week — have now shown Cheri in a statistical tie with both of our potential opponents. So with the general election about to start, this is an all-hands-on-deck moment:

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Walsh for Congress
body:
It is with a somber heart that I announce that I am withdrawing my candidacy for Congress. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/47848191e2b5/campaign-update-dear-friends?e=4df934edcc)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friends,

In some respects, it feels like a lifetime ago when my husband Steve and I decided to declare my candidacy for Congress in July of 2021. By the end of July, my husband and I caught COVID and my husband succumbed to complications from COVID pneumonia August 19, 2021. After a time of grief and prayer, I continued onward, partly in memory of my husband and partly to continue the race set before me - to continue fighting for God and Country like we did our entire marriage.

As State Representative for Missouri's House District 50, I currently represent constituents in Southern Boone and portions of Cooper, Moniteau and Cole counties. My current constituents are among my strongest supporters and dear friends and I was eagerly looking forward to representing them on a greater scale at the federal level, along with everyone else in Missouri's 4th Congressional District.

Last week, the General Assembly passed a new congressional map that moved me and all of my current constituents into the 3rd Congressional District. Still, I voted for the map because I believe it was good for conservatives and good for Missouri. However, the newly drawn district that removes my strongest base of support has a severe impact on the chances of success for my campaign.

In my travels over the past year throughout Missouri's current and proposed 4th Congressional District, I have met so many Missourians who stand with me in my pursuit of defending the American Dream. They have shared their stories with me of how they have lived their American Dream and of their concerns of the current and future impacts resulting from terrible decisions being made in Washington D.C.

In good conscience, I cannot continue to ask for sacrificial contributions for my campaign from good people who are suffering under skyrocketing gas prices, soaring food prices, baby formula shortages, and other inflationary challenges when my campaign may not be victorious due to the new Congressional District map.

Therefore, it is with a somber heart that I announce that I am withdrawing my candidacy for Congress.

There are several other Republican candidates who have filed to run in the August 2 Primary Election for Missouri's 4th Congressional District. I encourage you to research the candidates and choose for yourself whom you wish to support and to vote for as the CD4 election will be won in the primary as it is a strong Republican district.

To my supporters, may the Lord richly bless you and keep you. Thank you for having relentlessly stood with me, for your encouragement, for your prayers, and for your deep love for God and Country. I am forever grateful for your support. Do not be dismayed, the Lord is in control and ultimately He holds our future and every single breath. Pray. Research the candidates. And vote.

God bless,
Sara Walsh

**What to Take With You :**
* Palm Cards and/or Sample ballots about Doug
* Comfortable shoes
* A chair to sit and occasionally rest in between shifts of voters coming in
* A lightweight table if you have one
* Snacks and Drinks
* Contact person(s) if problem arises that needs immediate attention:
* **Your County Coordinator Number: _______________________

**Poll Greeting 101** :
* On average, up to 10% of voters who show up to the polls are still undecided
* You are only allowed to poll greet outside of the polling place (there will be a clear line you cannot go past)
* Poll greeting is important because you will be the last person that voter interacts with before they vote for Governor
* In many counties, voters will be getting a sample ballot that endorses another establishment candidate for governor
* You will be the one person who can speak positively about Doug before they go in to vote

**Poll Greeting Tips :**
* Position yourself so that you are the last person before the voter goes into vote
* There will likely be both GOP and Democrat committee tables at each polling place
* Ensure you have ample palm cards and/or sample ballots to hand out to voters
* Develop your quick pitch to voters on why they should vote for Doug (you may only have 10 seconds or less as the voter enters the polling place)

**Logistics :**
* Ensure that you contact your county coordinator before Election Day so that you have all the materials you will need
* You will be assigned to a “targeted” precinct by your county coordinator to ensure you are reaching the highest number of Republican voters

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Another Colorado Legislator endorses Erik Aadland
body:
Former State Senator and Representative
| | | |
---
|
---
|
# Greg Brophy Endorsement
---
|
---
|
---
| (May 13, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Greg Brophy.
Greg Brophy served as a Republican in the Colorado House of Representatives from the 63rd district from 2003 to 2005, and in the Colorado Senate from the 1st district from 2005 to 2015 and was later the chief of staff for U.S. Representative Ken Buck. In 2014, Brophy ran for Governor of Colorado and is currently the president of Brophy Strategies LLC.
---
|
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Brophy stated:
"Erik Aadland is the perfect candidate for the newly drawn CD7. He is a warrior, thinker, and the best chance we have to flip this contested seat. Being a candidate is not an easy task, yet Erik has proven his strength, endurance, and passion for country by putting 100% into this race every single day. He will make an extraordinary Congressman. Please join me in supporting Erik for congress."
---
|
---
|
---
| "Greg knows what it takes to win elections and to serve his constituency in office, so this endorsement speaks volumes.. As a previous Colorado state Representative and Senator, as well as a candidate for Governor, Greg knows first-hand the type of candidate we need to win elections in Colorado. I am grateful for his endorsement and encouraged that someone who has held critical political positions in Colorado views me as the strongest candidate to win this primary and the general in November. "
---
---
| |
---
|
---
| | [Send Erik your feedback](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001v7-1Gi1FFUPOzVfiuPrYHL9cZSteCYHuHooH-2Ax-OsbrXgSex5HLKpcQ4tRLpZ1KU9P1y9-bcLHY1c9__Zu748m7Ww4wiYd97rR0G_TgOpTr7VjFij4hV_DdvifJclmdj40wO4UB1Am2B_Vbufnd-qbRSOOPJWjlSGXAuGDHJ-zKC_j147fH-24LRX6impZRp3Q0CHGRLCSJ5rOpjFPkqi12dgKW1b6EGUJgfvRM4jftyjRYKdoppe1Dh9Q5LXu&c=SYIls-75sEI6H042ImMvjvYg3G9st5Zv-Lux0zS9VTU1Vi3Lq-ImXw==&ch=xiTC9aQaUR9a8FyKfq80-VMc3SLfZ90wJIkMzPmcHQKXhrpr7Fxv5w==)
---
| |
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

We are entirely dependent on private donations. With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of young people in this new free online course and expand Hillsdale’s other outreach efforts. body:
| Hey Friend, Just wanted to make sure you saw this virtual Zoom invite for tomorrow night. Hope you can join us! We'll be discussing which races and states Country First is engaged in this primary season, and will be watching the results come in for Madison Cawthorn's race -- and hopefully celebrating his defeat together! [Click here for the details and to RSVP so you will receive the Zoom link to attend](https://www.country1st.com/cawthorn?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cawthorn_followup_nd&n=1). See you tomorrow, Adam **< < Begin Forwarded Message >>** **** Friend --

This coming Tuesday, May 17th, is the primary election in North Carolina, and Country First has made bold moves to defeat one of the most toxic and ineffective members of Congress: Madison Cawthorn (you may have seen some rather unfortunate videos of him in the news lately...). All of our polling is showing that the media, mail, texting, and grassroots outreach we've done in the race is working -- Cawthorn's numbers have cratered! But in a crowded field, it's going to come down to the wire, and **we'd love for you to virtually watch the results come in with us.** | [](https://www.country1st.com/cawthorn?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cawthorn_followup_nd&n=2 "RSVP to Cawthorn DEFEAT PARTY") [RSVP to Cawthorn DEFEAT PARTY](https://www.country1st.com/cawthorn?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cawthorn_followup_nd&n=2)
---
We'll discuss the race, get updates as the numbers come in, and hear a preview of the other important races and states we're targeting. It's possible we won't know the winner by the time we wrap things up, but it's still a good excuse to get together and connect as a movement.
I hope you can make it on **Tuesday, May 17th** at 8:30 pm Eastern / 7:30 pm Central / 6:30 pm Mountain / 5:30 pm Pacific.
Our efforts will continue through Tuesday and beyond, so if you would like to assist as a [volunteer](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cawthorn_followup_nd&n=3) and/or continue to support us [financially](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cawthorn_followup_nd&n=4), please don't hesitate to get involved!
Hope to see you Tuesday. Fingers crossed for a great win!

Country First,

Adam

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45389329/345729757/2125767274?refcode=BLU-PUT-20220516-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTEwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGVkMTgxYy01OGQ1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4zxelR9NlcXavjzWlFkzlGbXdetkcg5Brk13NhTHOyc=)
On Friday, Stefanik advocated that babies who are in US custody at the border be denied baby formula, effectively starving them–in violation of basic morality and US law.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45389330/345729758/2125767274?refcode=BLU-PUT-20220516-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTEwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGVkMTgxYy01OGQ1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4zxelR9NlcXavjzWlFkzlGbXdetkcg5Brk13NhTHOyc=)
Later that day, she blamed Democrats and “pedo grifters” for the nationwide baby formula shortage–in a dog-whistle to QAnon conspiracy theorists.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45389331/345729759/2125767274?refcode=BLU-PUT-20220516-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTEwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGVkMTgxYy01OGQ1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4zxelR9NlcXavjzWlFkzlGbXdetkcg5Brk13NhTHOyc=)
On Saturday, a white nationalist targeted a Black community and murdered ten people. name: Mike Crispi
subject: YOU'RE INVITED: AMERICA FIRST REPUBLICANS STOP THE STEAL RALLY
body:
As the June 7th primary draws near, Republican Congressional candidate Mike Crispi and the entire America First slate have been out speaking with voters on the issues important to you: election integrity, Second Amendment Rights, protecting the Right to Life, and ending the broken political reign of establishment politicians like incumbent Congressman Chris Smith who care more about preserving their power than they do about putting our rights and our country first!

UPCOMING EVENTS

----------

Wednesday, May 18 - Second Amendment Rally

----------

America First Candidates from Monmouth and Ocean county will be hosting a Second Amendment rally, including special guest and NJ Second Amendment Society President Alexander Roubian to discuss the importance of protecting our right to bear arms from gun grabbing Democrats and RINO Republicans. Americans’ Second Amendment Rights are absolute. Let’s make sure they stay that way!

|

|

|

|

|

|

Friday, May 20 - STOP THE STEAL RALLY

----------

Mike Crispi and the America First Republicans will be hosting a STOP THE STEAL rally to raise awareness of the corrupt practices of the Ocean County Republican establishment and to protect our right to free and fair elections. The rally will include a screening of the newly released 2,000 Mules by writer and director Dinesh D’Souza.

|

|

|

|

|

|

Saturday, May 21 - PATRIOT SUNSET PARTY

----------

|

|

|

|

|

|

AMERICA FIRST REPUBLICANS IN ACTION

----------

America First Team (Fossa, Lamb, Crispi) out meeting voters and discussing medical and education freedom issues with 101.5 radio host Bill Spadea

|

|

|

|

|

|

Crispi for Congress and America First Republican supporters

|

|

|

|

|

|

The corrupt establishment is attacking our American values like never before, stealing our elections, and putting America last.

That’s why WE NEED YOUR HELP to end corrupt establishment politicians, like incumbent congressman Chris Smith, who has repeatedly voted to take away your Second Amendment Rights, establish a federal vaccine database, pass the Biden Build Back Better Green New Deal infrastructure bill, and has even taken blood money from big pharma companies who have profited off the deaths of the unborn.

As always, THANK YOU for your gracious support of the America First slate of candidates and for doing your part to protect our values and our country. Mike Crispi and the America First Republicans will always fight to protect our country, our scared rights, and MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN.

|

name: Heidi St. John
subject: Major Campaign Announcement!
body:
Dear Peter,

This afternoon I filed paperwork to replace Jaime Herrera Beutler as the next Congresswoman from Southwest Washington!

Over the next 2.5 months I'll be engulfed in the political fight of my life against at least two main opponents who're already spending big money to attack my character and my career.

I'll need lots of your prayers, encouragement, and financial support in the coming weeks! I'm forever grateful for my more than 5,000 donors here in Southwest Washington and across the country.

[**Please watch this 13 second video I recorded just moments after filing my paperwork!**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60164308:sMb2WNhMN:m:1:2503513073:BBE7491C264E00D60EAAB68C67AEE045:r)

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Young
people today grow up being told that their perception of reality
is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that
women can choose to be men and men women.

This
denial of objective reality-including a denial of an objective
good-is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and
of free government.

Largely
as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is
releasing its latest free online course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity."

Taught by
Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a
professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture
course covers Lewis's philosophical defense of an objective good
and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity.

I am
writing today to ask if you would consider pre-registering for
this free online course. You can do so at this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60164177:WbnEWNhNL:m:3:2532013465:9C14A9418E53D594E7BB4F3AFCAB1881:r

After
pre-registering for "C.S. Lewis on Christianity," please help us
meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16 to
promote this new online course effectively, especially to young
people.

Hillsdale
produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while
refusing to accept government funding-not even indirectly in the
form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely
dependent on private donations.

With your
tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of
young people in this new free online course and expand
Hillsdale's other outreach efforts.

Thank you
for your friendship and support.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Team Slotkin
subject: Pence in MI to fundraise for our opponent
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220516&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220516&amount=28]
Team,
Interesting news: Mike Pence will be at a fundraiser TOMORROW for our opponent.
It’s big news on its own, but it’s also noteworthy to know why he’s coming. Hint: it involves the DeVos family .
Recently, the DeVos family launched a petition drive in Michigan to give tax breaks to donors who fund school vouchers used at private institutions. This would mean that our tax dollars could be redirected to private and for-profit charter schools. If they’re successful at getting 340,000 validated signatures, the proposal will go straight back to the legislature for a vote. Because of Michigan's petition process, the legislature can vote on the measure and the Governor has no ability to veto it .
Elissa’s opponent is a big supporter of this initiative, and as a state Senator, he'll be voting on this legislation if the petition drive is successful. He has even sponsored similar legislation in the past. Meanwhile, he’s no friend of education: he’s voted against *every* K-12 education funding bill during his time in the legislature — even though his own party has the majority! He’s an ideologue who would rather give zero money to our kids than compromise on a bipartisan bill.
It’s not a coincidence that Elissa’s opponent is also heavily funded by the DeVos family – they’ve been among his biggest donors since he was first elected in 2014. A few weeks ago, they hosted a swanky fundraiser for him in Washington D.C., and gave him nearly $50,000 in one day – and that’s just the money we can see.
So where does the former Vice President come into all this? He’s in town to host a number of events in support of that DeVos-backed petition — one of which is a fundraiser for our opponent.
To sum up: Elissa’s opponent likes to say he’s a maverick who bucks his party — but he’s simply loyal to whoever funds him . In this case, the DeVos family. And now he’s being rewarded again with cash and an event with the former VP.
We’ve said it before, and we’ll say it again: DeVos money won’t buy this election. Will you chip in today to show the DeVos family they’re in for a tough fight?

Dear Friend,

Tomorrow, Pennsylvanians will head to the polls to vote in this year's primary election. And while typically the primaries don't mark the start of the end of our democracy, this time in PA, they very well might.

Conservative candidates are so terrifyingly right-wing this year that the Philadelphia Inquirer even refused to endorse one. Whomever we choose as our next senators or governor will set the path for our democracy. Will it live or will it die?

We can work together to protect it.

Peter,

We now know that the Supreme Court has already decided to overturn the life-saving legal precedent of _Roe v. Wade_ , which protected abortion access as a constitutional right for decades. I was in high school before _Roe_ was decided. I had friends who had horrible, back alley abortions. I saw firsthand the toll it took on them. Then in my senior year, _Roe v. Wade_ was decided, finally giving women control over their own bodies. Now our daughters and future generations will go back to the dark ages, if we allow the GOP to take control.

The decision to overturn _Roe_ was once unthinkable. But now we know what a GOP-controlled federal government would look like. We can no longer take anything for granted. If Republicans win back the House in November, they have promised to do all they can to take away the right to choose and allow state legislatures to decide whether a woman can make her own medical decisions.

My opponent is also not satisfied with just letting state legislatures decide this issue. He wants a **federal ban** on abortion. What's next? Taking away contraception, returning women to the days of no control over their own lives?

We **must** hold on to the Democratic House Majority, and that depends on holding my seat here in PA-07.

Wade is about to be overturned | = Peter, We now know that the Supreme Court has already decided to overturn the life-saving legal precedent of Roe v. Wade , which protected abortion access as a constitutional right for decades. I was in high school before Roe was decided. I had friends who had horrible, back alley abortions. I saw firsthand the toll it took on them. Then in my senior year, Roe v. Wade was decided, finally giving women control over their own bodies. Now our daughters and future generations will go back to the dark ages, if we allow the GOP to take control. The decision to overturn Roe was once unthinkable. But now we know what a GOP-controlled federal government would look like. We can no longer take anything for granted. If Republicans win back the House in November, they have promised to do all they can to take away the right to choose and allow state legislatures to decide whether a woman can make her own medical decisions. My opponent is also not satisfied with just letting state legislatures decide this issue. He wants a federal ban on abortion. What's next? Taking away contraception, returning women to the days of no control over their own lives? We must hold on to the Democratic House Majority, and that depends on holding my seat here in PA-07. = | = Everyone deserves to make their own decisions about their health and future. name: Margaret Cheney
subject: About my husband, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Will you add your name to support this grassroots team?

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=407%2E61531%2ETawRAA)
Hello,
I’d like to take a moment to talk about what I’ve noticed in Peter over the years, and why he’s exactly the type of public servant we need at this moment. But first, let me tell you a little bit about myself.
I’m a third-generation Vermonter, but I didn’t grow up here because my family lived overseas while my father served our country as a career Foreign Service officer. I grew up in Malaysia, the Netherlands, India, Peru, and Nicaragua, where I always attended neighborhood schools in the local language. After working as a journalist in Washington, I moved to Vermont to be near family and got involved in local community issues here—as a school board member, school board chair, and then state legislator.
Peter and I first met through public service. I was on the interstate school board at the time, and he was in the Vermont Senate, and a colleague and I had a hard question about school funding that we wanted to talk to him about. I could tell right away that he was a great listener, and that he would put his head down to work with others to solve problems.
Peter and I have been married almost 14 years now. We never tire of talking (especially about solving the climate crisis), and I’ve watched him fight for Vermonters from the Statehouse to the U.S. House.
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-join-our-team/?source=em_20220516_p_m_join&t=3&akid=407%2E61531%2ETawRAA)
Now, Peter is running to be Vermont’s next senator. We need to show the broad support he’s building from the grassroots level. [**So I’m asking: will you add your name to say you officially support Peter?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-join-our-team/?source=em_20220516_p_m_join&t=4&akid=407%2E61531%2ETawRAA)
[JOIN OUR TEAM](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-join-our-team/?source=em_20220516_p_m_join&t=8&t=9&akid=407%2E61531%2ETawRAA)
---
Peter’s running for Senate because our democracy is under threat, and because he knows we need All Hands On Deck to deliver progress.
From his days fighting housing discrimination in Chicago to his time as Vermont’s congressman, he’s worked consistently to advance social, racial, and economic justice—to address inequality and remove barriers to opportunity.
That’s why he’s committed to raising wages, lowering costs like housing and prescription drugs, getting the wealthy to pay their fair share of taxes, solving the climate crisis with its disproportionate harms on low-income Americans and people of color, and putting Washington on the side of families.
Peter’s ready to hit the ground running on Day One as a U.S. senator—and he’ll deliver results the _Vermont way_ , by focusing on solutions and listening more than he talks. But we need your support to elect him. [**If you believe in his vision for Vermont and our country, add your name right away to say you’re on this team.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-join-our-team/?source=em_20220516_p_m_join&t=5&akid=407%2E61531%2ETawRAA)
Thanks,
Margaret

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: It's been an honor to represent you – now let's win this election.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
With you by my side, I am proud of the work we've accomplished.
Peter,

It's official: I've filed for reelection, and I'm more motivated than ever to continue fighting for our community.
From my days working in economic development to serving in the Washington state Capitol, and now as your representative in Congress it has been my honor to serve the people of our region.

In recent years, we've made progress in the effort to help our nation recover from the pandemic. We've made progress in supporting our military families and veterans -- including building a new VA clinic in Kitsap County. We've made progress in securing record funding for salmon restoration and Puget Sound recovery. We've made progress by passing a historic infrastructure bill that will fix our roads and bridges and give people access to broadband.

**With you by my side, I am proud of the work we 've accomplished. But our work is not over yet. **

We have work to do to ensure all seniors can retire with dignity. That's why I've been working to increase Social Security benefits and empower Medicare to negotiate lower prices for prescription drugs.

We have work to do on behalf of middle-class families that are being squeezed by inflation and rising gas prices. That's why I'm working to pass an American competitiveness bill to prevent price increases caused by supply chain problems and to crack down on price gouging by oil companies.

We have work to do to protect our democracy. That's why I'm fighting for a new Voting Rights Act to combat voter suppression and protect the voting rights of every American. We have work to do to combat the climate crisis and invest in climate resilience. That's why I've supported legislation to address this generational challenge.

And we have work to do to stand up for reproductive health care. With the Senate failing to pass the Women's Health Protection Act and the Supreme Court poised to overturn _Roe_ , it's clear that we can't leave a single seat in the House or Senate up to chance!

My name will be on the ballot this November, and I'm hoping that I can count on the support of this grassroots team to build another winning campaign. **[Will you help my campaign keep going strong by contributing today?](https://act.myngp.com/el/uJI3OPXI_wh_mbB4b51U3rLYX9-s7uDziQnuloE68B8=/Qr63kvrIEi4SAvrcoYbbkReR8g8tONUgX_HFj0h3oWg=?refcode=em22_220516_filing_fndd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220516_filing_fndd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}) **

As always, it's an honor to serve you,

Derek Kilmer

Dear Friend, Today the United States Supreme Court voted to strike down a federal campaign finance regulation that prohibited Ted Cruz’s scheme to pay himself personally with money raised from donors after he wins an election. Richard Painter already commented on Ted Cruz’s scheme for MSNBC here: [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/ted-cruz-just-gave-donors-much-louder-voice-washington-n1269914](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=3a30b6ffb5&e=8914b14955) The scheme works like this: A wealthy candidate loans his campaign large amounts of money, uses that money to crush opposition in the primary and to win the general election. Then, after winning the election the candidate holds campaign fundraisers and solicits donations from persons eager to give money to an elected official personally to buy influence. The money is then transferred almost immediately by the campaign to the candidate’s personal bank account to pay off the “loan”. **Under the Supreme Court’s opinion, a multimillionaire can loan his campaign millions of dollars, win the election, and then pay himself back.** Why donate before the election to help a candidate win if you can wait until after the election, find out who wins and pay off the winner personally? If you thought giving cash to a candidate personally, or “donating” money to a candidate’s personal bank account was illegal bribery, you were right until today. **_Now it’s legal bribery. _** The Supreme Court - _the same Supreme Court that said corporations have a free speech right in Citizens United and that could soon reverse Roe v. Wade - has ruled that post-election personal payoffs to federal officials are not only legal, but a constitutional right._ We need to fix campaign finance. And we need to fix the Supreme Court. Richard will get it done! In the First Congressional District DFL primary Richard faces an opponent, former Hormel Foods CEO Jeff Ettinger, who has an enormous personal fortune of tens of millions of dollars. Richard needs your help to take back Congress for the 99%! [Can you help today with a contribution of $5, $25, $50, $100 or $250 today? We need to make sure we elect a Representative who is looking out for the 99% not the 1%.](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=5ec520f342&e=8914b14955) Thanks, -Team Painter

[**STAND WITH JOHN**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkM1OxCAUhZ-m3dGU3xkXXZiY2enCmLgkFG5bxgINUEffXtDp3oQN3-WcezhmMNoorFs7kJ6QnmOBT5z2pDv1VDOs4EFgGDEmDevVCjF3EbZ9XK1WPqv0MYWoodPBtctA9Zn0E_ARuMFMs4mNglJDOR8FTGJs35_ls7Kr9fOLcjDEPMmYpHUzyGsBCYWvbxdi8JIjLBAhkrTrsOS8pYY-NuRSTgK9R-hu1kcwdXFh17B49OdQ8iBn9WJn5ctE6WyDR4yIMz0ztKlqQi97djKFvURv6FOFohKt3Kbs7Au7C-4DB8burj6NIW13mCFW9GnhduiDz-DzYRlr0lg-W0COOxw6Xe6vbxd0FN7GwWw3u642iVOpeXalo99K878q-gEiKZSo)
---
Friend, this is no different than when Joe Biden told black voters: “you ain’t black” if they didn’t support him. I have the right to think for myself along with all other Americans, including black Americans. My vote is my right, I don’t owe it to anyone. **The left is panicking - that’s what this is about.** They’re losing more support every day because they’ve taken black voters for granted for years. Black Americans care about the same issues as everyone else: a strong economy, good schools, and a safe community to raise a family. **And right now, Joe Biden and Democrats are failing miserably on all of those fronts.** We need people who can lead in Washington - who think for themselves regardless of party politics. **[I’ll be that leader in Congress - can I count on you to help get me there by chipping in $25 to my fight?](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkM1OxCAUhZ-m3dGU3xkXXZiY2enCmLgkFG5bxgINUEffXtDp3oQN3-WcezhmMNoorFs7kJ6QnmOBT5z2pDv1VDOs4EFgGDEmDevVCjF3EbZ9XK1WPqv0MYWoodPBtctA9Zn0E_ARuMFMs4mNglJDOR8FTGJs35_ls7Kr9fOLcjDEPMmYpHUzyGsBCYWvbxdi8JIjLBAhkrTrsOS8pYY-NuRSTgK9R-hu1kcwdXFh17B49OdQ8iBn9WJn5ctE6WyDR4yIMz0ztKlqQi97djKFvURv6FOFohKt3Kbs7Au7C-4DB8burj6NIW13mCFW9GnhduiDz-DzYRlr0lg-W0COOxw6Xe6vbxd0FN7GwWw3u642iVOpeXalo99K878q-gEiKZSo)** I want people to support me based upon the fruits of my actions – not on hearsay, political affiliation and certainly not based on the color of my skin. Now here’s why you should support me:
---
[](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkM1OxCAUhZ-m3dGU3xkXXZiY2enCmLgkFG5bxgINUEffXtDp3oQN3-WcezhmMNoorFs7kJ6QnmOBT5z2pDv1VDOs4EFgGDEmDevVCjF3EbZ9XK1WPqv0MYWoodPBtctA9Zn0E_ARuMFMs4mNglJDOR8FTGJs35_ls7Kr9fOLcjDEPMmYpHUzyGsBCYWvbxdi8JIjLBAhkrTrsOS8pYY-NuRSTgK9R-hu1kcwdXFh17B49OdQ8iBn9WJn5ctE6WyDR4yIMz0ztKlqQi97djKFvURv6FOFohKt3Kbs7Au7C-4DB8burj6NIW13mCFW9GnhduiDz-DzYRlr0lg-W0COOxw6Xe6vbxd0FN7GwWw3u642iVOpeXalo99K878q-gEiKZSo)
---
I've always been guided by these core principles: _faith in God and country_ , a _strong united family_ , and _service before self_.
And that’s what American leadership is lacking these days--we have a lot of people in government who either talk a good game about helping the American people or are the career politicians who are getting things done.
But real leaders can do both.
Leadership is more than just listening to people’s concerns, it’s sacrificing your own needs behind someone else's and not accepting failure as an option.
We need a leader who can restore faith in the American system, be a champion for American families, and serve and fulfill the interests of the American public.
**[I know I can be that leader for Michigan and beyondーI’m asking for your trust and support to help me get there >>](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkM1OxCAUhZ-m3dGU3xkXXZiY2enCmLgkFG5bxgINUEffXtDp3oQN3-WcezhmMNoorFs7kJ6QnmOBT5z2pDv1VDOs4EFgGDEmDevVCjF3EbZ9XK1WPqv0MYWoodPBtctA9Zn0E_ARuMFMs4mNglJDOR8FTGJs35_ls7Kr9fOLcjDEPMmYpHUzyGsBCYWvbxdi8JIjLBAhkrTrsOS8pYY-NuRSTgK9R-hu1kcwdXFh17B49OdQ8iBn9WJn5ctE6WyDR4yIMz0ztKlqQi97djKFvURv6FOFohKt3Kbs7Au7C-4DB8burj6NIW13mCFW9GnhduiDz-DzYRlr0lg-W0COOxw6Xe6vbxd0FN7GwWw3u642iVOpeXalo99K878q-gEiKZSo)**
---
[**FUEL OUR FIGHT >>>**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkM1OxCAUhZ-m3dGU3xkXXZiY2enCmLgkFG5bxgINUEffXtDp3oQN3-WcezhmMNoorFs7kJ6QnmOBT5z2pDv1VDOs4EFgGDEmDevVCjF3EbZ9XK1WPqv0MYWoodPBtctA9Zn0E_ARuMFMs4mNglJDOR8FTGJs35_ls7Kr9fOLcjDEPMmYpHUzyGsBCYWvbxdi8JIjLBAhkrTrsOS8pYY-NuRSTgK9R-hu1kcwdXFh17B49OdQ8iBn9WJn5ctE6WyDR4yIMz0ztKlqQi97djKFvURv6FOFohKt3Kbs7Au7C-4DB8burj6NIW13mCFW9GnhduiDz-DzYRlr0lg-W0COOxw6Xe6vbxd0FN7GwWw3u642iVOpeXalo99K878q-gEiKZSo)
---
Friend, a lot of people know of me, but they don't know how I got here or why they should put their faith in me to lead. My family story is inextricably linked to the American Dream, and I wouldn’t be where I am today without the opportunity and promise offered by our great country. My father was born in Starkville, Mississippi, and he grew up right across the street from a university he wasn’t allowed to attend because of the color of his skin. But he didn’t let racism and bigotry deny him the ability to embrace the promise of America — he paid his way through college, served honorably in Vietnam, and worked hard to provide a better future for his family.
---
| | [](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkM1OxCAUhZ-m3dGU3xkXXZiY2enCmLgkFG5bxgINUEffXtDp3oQN3-WcezhmMNoorFs7kJ6QnmOBT5z2pDv1VDOs4EFgGDEmDevVCjF3EbZ9XK1WPqv0MYWoodPBtctA9Zn0E_ARuMFMs4mNglJDOR8FTGJs35_ls7Kr9fOLcjDEPMmYpHUzyGsBCYWvbxdi8JIjLBAhkrTrsOS8pYY-NuRSTgK9R-hu1kcwdXFh17B49OdQ8iBn9WJn5ctE6WyDR4yIMz0ztKlqQi97djKFvURv6FOFohKt3Kbs7Au7C-4DB8burj6NIW13mCFW9GnhduiDz-DzYRlr0lg-W0COOxw6Xe6vbxd0FN7GwWw3u642iVOpeXalo99K878q-gEiKZSo)

| He moved to Detroit and started a trucking company with only one truck and one trailer. He worked for more than a decade hauling beer between Detroit and Milwaukee and turned that one truck and one trailer into a 35 million dollar company. In four generations, my family has gone from slave to sharecropper to potential Congressman because of their relentless hard work and the opportunity and promise offered by the American system.

My family story is inextricably linked to the American Dream, and I wouldn’t be where I am today without the opportunity and promise offered by our great country. My father was born in Starkville, Mississippi, and he grew up right across the street from a university he wasn’t allowed to attend because of the color of his skin. But he didn’t let racism and bigotry deny him the ability to embrace the promise of America — he paid his way through college, served honorably in Vietnam, and worked hard to provide a better future for his family. | | | He moved to Detroit and started a trucking company with only one truck and one trailer. He worked for more than a decade hauling beer between Detroit and Milwaukee and turned that one truck and one trailer into a 35 million dollar company. In four generations, my family has gone from slave to sharecropper to potential Congressman because of their relentless hard work and the opportunity and promise offered by the American system. | | My family story inspired me to believe in the promise offered by the American Dream, and my father’s service inspired me to use my skills and blessings to defend it to the best of my ability. Now I want to ensure it's safeguarded and passed down to my sons and the next generation. | | | I hope you choose to become an OFFICIAL supporter of my campaign by making an immediate donation now: Thank you for your time, Friend. ,

I'm wholeheartedly committed to fighting back against the woke indoctrination agenda of the radical left.

Our children are too important to leave in the hands of woke school boards - especially when the school boards care more about their political agendas than about our children's educations.

On May 21st, voting will be open from 9am-4pm. Your voting location is determined by where you live, and you will not be allowed to vote anywhere other than your designated voting location. You can find a full list of voting locations at [www.JeanineLawson.com/Voting](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=7e279763da&e=fc83fb200d)

For additional help determining your voting location, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com) and we can help you determine where to vote.

**Prince William County: **your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district.

If you live in **Brentsville District represented by Supervisor Jeanine Lawson** , your voting location will be Gainesville Middle School located at 8001 Limestone Drive, Gainesville.

If you live in **Gainesville District represented by Supervisor Pete Candland**, your voting location will be Bull Run Middle School located at 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville.

If you live in **Coles District represented by Supervisor Yesli Vega or in Occoquan District**, your voting location will be Lake Jackson Fire Station located at 11310 Coles Drive, Manassas.

**Loudoun County: **Your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district _unless you live in Blue Ridge District represented by Supervisor Tony Buffington._

If you live in **Blue Ridge district** , your district is split between two voting locations. Find your precinct by visiting the [State Board of Elections website](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=db30da9cbb&e=fc83fb200d).
Blue Ridge precincts 301, 302, 303, 305, 308, 310, 311, and 315 vote at Loudoun Valley High School.
Blue Ridge precincts 307, 309, 312, 313, 314, 316, 318, 319, 320, 321, and 322 vote at Mercer Middle School.

If you live in **Catoctin, Leesburg, or portions of Blue Ridge** districts, your voting location will be Loudoun Valley High School located at 340 N. Maple Avenue, Purcellville.

If you live in **Algonkian, Ashburn, or Broad Run** districts, your voting location is Broad Run High School located at 21670 Ashburn Road, Ashburn.

If you live in **Sterling, Dulles, or portions of Blue Ridge **districts, your voting location is Mercer Middle School located at 42149 Greenstone Drive, Aldie.

**Fauquier County:** Your county-wide voting location will be Fauquier High School located at 705 Waterloo Road, Warrenton.

**Rappahannock County** : Your county-wide voting location will be Rappahannock County Elementary School located at 34 Schoolhouse Road, Washington.

**Fairfax County** : Your voting location for all voters in the 10th district will be the Clifton Town Hall located at 12641 Chapel Road, Clifton.

**Manassas City** : Your city-wide voting location will be Grace E. Metz Middle School located at 9950 Wellington Road, Manassas.

**Manassas Park City** : Your city-wide voting location will be the Manassas Park Community Center located at 99 Adams Street, Manassas Park.

If you have any questions, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com)and we can help you determine where to vote.

body:
Introduce Greg to your Friends and Acquaintances

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=b9990716b3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_47&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-b9990716b3-584862049

Good Afternoon -

As someone who is following me and my campaign, I have created this video for you to introduce me to your friends, family, or acquaintances whom I am poised to represent as their next Governor of Colorado.

A significant portion of my campaign effort has been to introduce myself and connect with those who agree with me and with those who disagree and, what I have come to find out is, that those who disagree are simply misinformed or uninformed.

They actually agree with my message. A lot.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hh1Xk0Rd62M&utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=b9990716b3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_47&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-b9990716b3-584862049
Who is Greg Lopez? Greg wants you to know him better.

I am out there every day turning the hearts and minds of hundreds of Coloradans who vote Unaffiliated, who vote Democrat, or who have never voted at all because my message of putting people over politics resonates with everyone.

I need your help! Please share this video introduction - particularly for those who have been betrayed and harmed by their party's public policies and are ready for a change.

I want to actively engage with those very people who have been misinformed or misled and bring them into the fold where we believe that people lead the government, not the other way around.

My message is not Democrat or Republican. My message is Coloradan. My message is putting faith, hope, and power back to people from all walks of life in all communities throughout all 64 counties of this great state.

Please make an introduction to everyone you know who had a hard four years and wants to make the next four something completely different -- something we all can be proud of and prosperous.

Respectfully,

** Please allow me to introduce myself...
------------------------------------------------------------

** Get To Know Me Better
------------------------------------------------------------
Who Is Greg Lopez? (https://www.lopez2022.com/meetgreg?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=b9990716b3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_47&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-b9990716b3-584862049)

============================================================
** (http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=b9990716b3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_47&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-b9990716b3-584862049)

| | Hey Peter, Following a great weekend on the campaign trail, I wanted to share some of my favorite moments with you. On Saturday, we celebrated the official office opening for our campaign — on Main Street in Royal Oak. It was incredibly special to share this event with my dad, Sandy, and valued members of the community in the Eleventh District. We talked about protecting access to reproductive rights, the recent success of unions nationwide, and just how much we can accomplish within the progressive coalition ahead of this year’s midterm elections. [_**We’re running a scrappy field program here and will need folks like you to volunteer with us. If you can, click here to sign up — there’s lots of different ways to get involved!**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45393246/345746052/-2106176305?refcode=em_20220516_f_a_events&ms=em_20220516_f_a_events&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwNzZmNC02NmQ1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aE1LQwD05sgVy-Yerq7dXh26dPixf686FWtEF3S8jxU=&emci=327315d5-57d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=291076f4-66d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=22034926) Later in the day, we put our feet to the pavement and rallied for abortion rights — and ran into a few friends along the way! Abortion is healthcare, and both individuals who seek abortions and those who provide them deserve protections. Let’s keep fighting to keep these bans off of our bodies. Yesterday, I spent my morning participating in the Birmingham Hometown Parade. Thank you to all of the awesome volunteers who showed up and marched along with us! Along the route, we passed Old Woodward on the corner of Maple — the location of my great grandparents’ general store from the 1890s. As I look back to the five generations of Levins in this district, I am more inspired to keep fighting for the future we all deserve. To fight for that future, we need you to get involved with our campaign as we fight for a progressive future in Michigan’s Eleventh District. Click here to join our weekly virtual [_**phonebanks**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45393247/345746053/1630866639?refcode=em_20220516_f_a_events&ms=em_20220516_f_a_events&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwNzZmNC02NmQ1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aE1LQwD05sgVy-Yerq7dXh26dPixf686FWtEF3S8jxU=&emci=327315d5-57d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=291076f4-66d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=22034926), or [_**donate**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45393248/345746054/478999150?refcode=em_20220516_f_a_events&ms=em_20220516_f_a_events&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTEwNzZmNC02NmQ1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aE1LQwD05sgVy-Yerq7dXh26dPixf686FWtEF3S8jxU=) to our campaign today. clean_body: Following a great weekend on the campaign trail, I wanted to share some of my favorite moments with you and other dedicated members of Team Levin. | | | | | Hey Peter, Following a great weekend on the campaign trail, I wanted to share some of my favorite moments with you. On Saturday, we celebrated the official office opening for our campaign — on Main Street in Royal Oak. It was incredibly special to share this event with my dad, Sandy, and valued members of the community in the Eleventh District. We talked about protecting access to reproductive rights, the recent success of unions nationwide, and just how much we can accomplish within the progressive coalition ahead of this year’s midterm elections. Later in the day, we put our feet to the pavement and rallied for abortion rights — and ran into a few friends along the way! Abortion is healthcare, and both individuals who seek abortions and those who provide them deserve protections. Let’s keep fighting to keep these bans off of our bodies. Yesterday, I spent my morning participating in the Birmingham Hometown Parade. Thank you to all of the awesome volunteers who showed up and marched along with us! Along the route, we passed Old Woodward on the corner of Maple — the location of my great grandparents’ general store from the 1890s. As I look back to the five generations of Levins in this district, I am more inspired to keep fighting for the future we all deserve. To fight for that future, we need you to get involved with our campaign as we fight for a progressive future in Michigan’s Eleventh District. | | **ICYMI: CONGRESSIONAL CANDIDATE DR. JOHN DI PAOLA RESPONDS TO BIDEN'S FAILURE TO ADDRESS BABY FORMULA SHORTAGE**
---
| WILSONVILLE, OR (MAY 13, 2022)— Today, Congressional Candidate Dr. John Di Paola called out the Biden Administration’s failure to protect newborn babies and support working families.
> _“This administration continues to abandon the most vulnerable members of our society; from imposing arbitrary lockdowns and mandates on school-aged children, to now refusing to act on the nationwide baby formula shortage. The President has failed to fulfill his responsibility to protect our next generation._
> _“It is unacceptable that in America a parent can’t meet the basic needs of their newborns as a result of a government induced shortage. Access to baby formula is essential for new parents. Joe Biden’s priorities are not focused on the safety, security, and success of American taxpayers. We need leaders who put America first.”_
Dr. John Di Paola is a retired Orthopedic Surgeon running for Oregon’s Fifth Congressional District. Dr. Di Paola is a Republican who brings decades of expertise as a medical professional and a small business owner to the race. Dr. Di Paola is running for Congress to end the status quo of career politicians who do not put Oregonians first. OR-05 includes parts of Multnomah, Clackamas, Marion, Linn, and Deschutes Counties.

body:
Peter, I was one of the first civilians savagely beaten by lawless Antifa thugs. I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist, to document and report on the event. As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety. The mob was angry and looking for a fight. Most of them wore masks -- and not the kind we're forced today because of coronavirus. They wanted to act like criminals without getting caught. Many had on helmets and makeshift armor. Some carried weapons like metal pipes, chains, crowbars, and even bricks. I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on. **People like you needed to know what was happening. ** But I didn't go unnoticed for long. Somebody recognized me and jeers quickly rose through the crowd. "F*** you, Andy Ngo!" and "Go home, fascist!" I tried to escape, but it was too late. **Projectiles started flying. Then came the fists. ** Before I knew it, I was being punched, kicked, and hit with flying objects. I tried to protect my head, but I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger. Not to mention they stole my camera. What they did to me is unacceptable. But this last summer, it became much worse than I could've ever imagined as Antifa set fire to entire cities for weeks on end. **And now, we 're watching Antifa and similar groups threaten mass riots and violence across the country.** **[Will you donate $35 or more to help me cover the costs of my lawsuit against Antifa?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60402042:67NY-aoNP:m:1:3317145305:97CFD4007B779567E48ADF798B1DF54A:r)** This is bigger than me alone. You see, after I got away from the mob, police finally showed up to question me, but my attackers stole all my evidence. Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured the attack, clear as day. I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved. Wrong. To this day, over a year later, my attackers are walking free. Portland police did nothing. No charges. No convictions. No justice. It's not much of a surprise, though. You see, radical politicians have long-since bowed to the dangerous mob that terrorizes their streets. And now, as you and I are watching Antifa's nationwide takeover, more and more politicians across the country are following suit. It's so bad that the justice system is buckling under the pressure of threats of violence from these disgusting thugs. We have to stop them and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family. **[That 's why I hope you'll join the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my landmark lawsuit against Antifa and their members.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60402042:67NY-aoNP:m:1:3317145305:97CFD4007B779567E48ADF798B1DF54A:r)** Because Antifa wants the end of America as we know it -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement. Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse - open anarchists who want to tear down our society and remake it in their own twisted vision. By any means necessary, **_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem. _** And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable. It's a sick strategy, but very smart - because so far, they've been right! **For the most part, they 've gotten off scot-free.**** ** Our politicians and media are treating this deranged terrorist group like peaceful protestors! As we've seen, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continues to escape consequences. **So now I 'm taking justice into my own hands - with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty. ** And, as I mentioned, we're suing Portland's Antifa Chapter. We've made a lot of progress in this case, but we're far from victory. **[You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60402042:67NY-aoNP:m:1:3317145305:97CFD4007B779567E48ADF798B1DF54A:r)** Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger. This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't. This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe. And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver. By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable. **[Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to fund this critical lawsuit?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60402042:67NY-aoNP:m:1:3317145305:97CFD4007B779567E48ADF798B1DF54A:r)** Please don't wait - if we don't fight back and win now, these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America, destroying everything and everyone in their path. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely, Andy Ngo Investigative Journalist P.S. I know firsthand that America's troubles with Antifa aren't over-- _**they 're just beginning**_. Defend the Border, Secure our Economy, Protect Life | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/brnoforaz/may-newsletter-az-under-fire?e=6dcd2506d1)
---
| | |

| | |

|
---
| ,

In Arizona, life is one of our most sacred values. From the lives of the preborn, to the lives and livelihoods of those who put themselves in between us and those who want to destroy us, it’s my most sacred duty as a public servant to defend them.

A lot has happened this month so far in the fight to defend Arizona’s values and lives. Since day one of the Biden administration, I’ve been fighting the President’s and Mark Kelly’s radical open border policy. They handed our state over to the Cartels, but I’ve been striking back. From defending Trump’s border wall and Remain in Mexico policy, to the Public Charge rule and Title 42, nothing that Biden has done in Arizona went unchecked.

Title 42 is particularly important for Arizona. During the Trump years, our border was in decent shape. We were at war with the Cartels, we were building a wall, and migrants knew that Trump wasn’t going to sit back and wait. He took action and took border security seriously. It worked and Arizonans were delighted that someone came to our aid.

The very day Biden took the White House, the Cartels knew America was open for business. The Biden administration rolled back every Trump policy defending us and announced they were halting deportations. Illegal crossings immediately spiked. In just the first year of the Biden administration, more than four times the number of migrants have crossed the border than in President Trump’s entire term.

Revoking Title 42 is just the most recent step from the radical left to transform America—and they openly admits it. The Biden administration said they “expect” a massive migrant surge when the title was rescinded. This Trump era policy gave our border patrol the tools they needed to expedite deportations. During the COVID-era the most deportations occurred under Title 42. It was essential to defend it. So I did. We were granted a temporary restraining order, twice halting the end of this program, but this week we expect a final decision. Right now it’s more critical than ever that we make our voices heard. I hope you’ll join me and the BrnoBrigade as we fight for Arizona’s security.
---
|
---
| Mark Brnovich

_P.S. This month, we discovered through a spineless, partisan leak that the Supreme Court might issue a decision about overturning Roe v. Wade.[Click here to see my ](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=4a0be8eac9&e=6dcd2506d1)[statement on](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=aab4cc5d31&e=6dcd2506d1) [Dobbs v. Jackson](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=2c5e2e47c6&e=6dcd2506d1). And once again, [Phoenix is leading the nation in inflation](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=7d8e337793&e=6dcd2506d1). Not a record I love to see. Biden’s inflation blunder is destroying our way of life. I’m running to secure our state and turn this crisis around._

body:
So grateful
#
Derek,
In case you haven’t heard, on Friday, my João had a stroke caused by a clot from his heart being in an irregular rhythm.
(In typical fashion, John was so focused on the campaign he didn’t want to go get it checked out until I made him. Moral of the story: Always listen to me 😉)
The amazing professionals at Lancaster General Hospital were able to completely clear the clot + reverse the stroke. They also got his heart under control.
TL:DR: John’s in a much better place and the doctors say he’s well on his way to a full recovery.
**I guess when your heart is that big and it carries so much love for the state, sometimes it asks for a rest. ❤️**
The kind doctors are keeping him here for observation for now, but they have assured us that he will be back on the trail soon. But first, under doctors’ orders — and my orders — he needs a moment to rest + recover.
**[Derek, would you add your name to a Get Well Soon card for João as he recovers? Your support truly means so much to us right now.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-get-well-soon-card/?source=em20220516-5853&t=1&akid=5853%2E434096%2E6nrYeL)**

We want to thank the amazing professionals here at Lancaster General Hospital. It means the world to us. And of course, please get out and vote on Tuesday!
With love,
Gisele ❤️

The State Party is ready to celebrate the brighter future leaders like André Carson, Frank Mrvan, and Robin Kelly have created for Hoosiers. From new jobs, regional economic development, and a once-in-a-generation investment in our infrastructure – Democrats have delivered for families in all 92 counties in Indiana and nationwide. body:
Ethics scandals have plagued our federal courts for decades. I’ve got a plan to fight back. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45396697/345767103/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ5D_JUD_E_20220516_V2S1_f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjUzNWJkNC03N2Q1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xfJ7aZIZ6xjd-ShfdUvNiFQXrb3WDnEASPcQqDw1M-Q=&emci=ee069703-71d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=2b535bd4-77d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=9027908)
---
Public trust in the Supreme Court has collapsed to historic lows — and it isn’t hard to see why. A truly radical draft opinion is poised to overturn decades of settled law on abortion rights. Justice Clarence Thomas failed to recuse himself from a case on the attempted coup that his wife participated in. Justices accept lavish international trips and fail to file basic financial disclosure reports. And it’s not just the top of the judicial branch: **ethics scandals have plagued our federal courts for decades.** Clerks have accused federal judges of sexual misconduct with little to no recourse. Judges and justices alike sit in cases in which they own individual stock in the parties — and in cases that could directly affect their spouses. **The judicial branch needs real ethics reform, from top to bottom. I’ve got a plan for that: Last week, Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal and I introduced the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act. ** From banning federal judges from owning individual stocks to overhauling the broken judicial recusal process, my bill would help root out corruption and restore public trust in the federal judiciary. But first, we have to fight side by side — as a grassroots movement — to get this bill through Congress. [**Add your name as a grassroots co-sponsor of our Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45396699/345767110/-1509511499?refcode=EMZ5D_JUD_E_20220516_V2S1_f&ms=EMZ5D_JUD_E_20220516_V2S1_f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjUzNWJkNC03N2Q1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xfJ7aZIZ6xjd-ShfdUvNiFQXrb3WDnEASPcQqDw1M-Q=&emci=ee069703-71d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=2b535bd4-77d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=9027908) Corruption is toxic to our democracy. But just this week, the Supreme Court’s conservative supermajority opened the floodgates for more corruption across the rest of the federal branches: They ruled that campaigns can blow past limits on raking in donations _after elections_ specifically to pay off the candidate’s personal loans to the campaign. Justice Elena Kagan ripped the majority a new one in her dissent: “Political contributions that will line a candidate’s own pockets, given after his election to office, pose a special danger of corruption...In striking down the law today, the Court greenlights all the sordid bargains Congress thought right to stop.” We need to fight back against those types of “sordid bargains” — including in the federal judiciary. Here are a few big pieces of how our bill would give Americans confidence that their judges are held to the highest ethical standards and are free from conflicts of interest:
* Banning federal judges from owning individual stocks and securities, commercial real estate, trusts, and other investments.

* Strengthening restrictions on judicial gifts and privately funded travel.

* Imposing the existing Code of Conduct for U.S. Judges on the Supreme Court — the only court in the country not currently subject to an ethical code.

* Improving disclosure of judicial speeches and case assignments, while mandating the livestreaming of court proceedings and new judicial workplace surveys.

* Requiring Supreme Court Justices to issue written recusal decisions whenever a litigant requests recusal and forcing the Judicial Conference to issue advisory opinions with their recusal recommendations.

* Closing the loophole that allows judges to escape accountability by retiring from the bench, strengthening disciplinary authority for the Judicial Conference, setting up expedited impeachment procedures for federal judges, and allowing the public to file complaints against Supreme Court Justices — like all other federal judges — through a new Supreme Court Complaints Review Committee.

* Limiting the ability of courts to seal records that contain important information for the protection of public health or safety, often concealed at the urging of massive corporations.

Look: Congresswoman Jayapal and I aren’t new to this issue. We’ve also put out the most ambitious anti-corruption plan since Watergate — targeting corruption across the federal government. And we’ve called on Chief Justice John Roberts to clean up the judiciary — including after the revelations about Justice Thomas’s recent failure to recuse himself, and after a report that over 131 federal judges violated federal law and ethics guidelines by overseeing cases involving companies in which they or their family members owned individual stock. But Chief Justice Roberts has simply failed to act. So we’ve got a plan to do it for him. Beyond this bill, there’s more we can do to restore faith in an independent judiciary committed to the rule of law. I’ve been pushing to expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats to rebalance this institution that’s been hijacked by right-wing extremists. But let’s make progress by tackling corruption. **There’s real momentum behind the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act — 19 of our colleagues in Congress, and a multitude of national organizations are already on board. But now we need to show that the American people are raising their voices on this.** [**Will you add your name to say you support our Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act? Make your voice heard on this issue that is powerfully important to our democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45396700/345767125/-1509511499?refcode=EMZ5D_JUD_E_20220516_V2S1_f&ms=EMZ5D_JUD_E_20220516_V2S1_f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjUzNWJkNC03N2Q1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xfJ7aZIZ6xjd-ShfdUvNiFQXrb3WDnEASPcQqDw1M-Q=&emci=ee069703-71d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=2b535bd4-77d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=9027908) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

clean_body: Ethics scandals have plagued our federal courts for decades. I’ve got a plan to fight back. | | | Public trust in the Supreme Court has collapsed to historic lows — and it isn’t hard to see why. A truly radical draft opinion is poised to overturn decades of settled law on abortion rights. Justice Clarence Thomas failed to recuse himself from a case on the attempted coup that his wife participated in. Justices accept lavish international trips and fail to file basic financial disclosure reports. And it’s not just the top of the judicial branch: ethics scandals have plagued our federal courts for decades. Clerks have accused federal judges of sexual misconduct with little to no recourse. Judges and justices alike sit in cases in which they own individual stock in the parties — and in cases that could directly affect their spouses. The judicial branch needs real ethics reform, from top to bottom. I’ve got a plan for that: Last week, Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal and I introduced the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act. From banning federal judges from owning individual stocks to overhauling the broken judicial recusal process, my bill would help root out corruption and restore public trust in the federal judiciary. But first, we have to fight side by side — as a grassroots movement — to get this bill through Congress. Corruption is toxic to our democracy. But just this week, the Supreme Court’s conservative supermajority opened the floodgates for more corruption across the rest of the federal branches: They ruled that campaigns can blow past limits on raking in donations after elections specifically to pay off the candidate’s personal loans to the campaign. Justice Elena Kagan ripped the majority a new one in her dissent: “Political contributions that will line a candidate’s own pockets, given after his election to office, pose a special danger of corruption...In striking down the law today, the Court greenlights all the sordid bargains Congress thought right to stop.” We need to fight back against those types of “sordid bargains” — including in the federal judiciary. Here are a few big pieces of how our bill would give Americans confidence that their judges are held to the highest ethical standards and are free from conflicts of interest: Banning federal judges from owning individual stocks and securities, commercial real estate, trusts, and other investments. Strengthening restrictions on judicial gifts and privately funded travel. Imposing the existing Code of Conduct for U.S. Judges on the Supreme Court — the only court in the country not currently subject to an ethical code. Improving disclosure of judicial speeches and case assignments, while mandating the livestreaming of court proceedings and new judicial workplace surveys. Requiring Supreme Court Justices to issue written recusal decisions whenever a litigant requests recusal and forcing the Judicial Conference to issue advisory opinions with their recusal recommendations. Closing the loophole that allows judges to escape accountability by retiring from the bench, strengthening disciplinary authority for the Judicial Conference, setting up expedited impeachment procedures for federal judges, and allowing the public to file complaints against Supreme Court Justices — like all other federal judges — through a new Supreme Court Complaints Review Committee. Limiting the ability of courts to seal records that contain important information for the protection of public health or safety, often concealed at the urging of massive corporations. Look: Congresswoman Jayapal and I aren’t new to this issue. We’ve also put out the most ambitious anti-corruption plan since Watergate — targeting corruption across the federal government. And we’ve called on Chief Justice John Roberts to clean up the judiciary — including after the revelations about Justice Thomas’s recent failure to recuse himself, and after a report that over 131 federal judges violated federal law and ethics guidelines by overseeing cases involving companies in which they or their family members owned individual stock. But Chief Justice Roberts has simply failed to act. So we’ve got a plan to do it for him. Beyond this bill, there’s more we can do to restore faith in an independent judiciary committed to the rule of law. I’ve been pushing to expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats to rebalance this institution that’s been hijacked by right-wing extremists. But let’s make progress by tackling corruption. There’s real momentum behind the Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act — 19 of our colleagues in Congress, and a multitude of national organizations are already on board. But now we need to show that the American people are raising their voices on this. body:
There is No Safe Level of Fentanyl

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=5565fbad7d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_05&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-5565fbad7d-584862049

Dear Colorado Voter,

As your next Governor, I will work with law enforcement across the state to reduce crime by 30% in two years by giving them the tools they need to keep our communities safe.

What is the situation today?

Two Colorado Cities Cited by US Drug Enforcement Administration as part of a ‘national fentanyl spike’

All possession of Fentanyl MUST be a Felony

Fentanyl is 50 times more potent than heroin and 100 times more lethal than morphine.

2-3 milligrams
Fentanyl is FATAL to one person.

The US Drug Enforcement Administration identified Cortez and Commerce City as two Colorado cities involving three or more “mass fentanyl over-dose events” close in time at the same location as part of a ‘national spike’.

According to Families Against Fentanyl, deaths attributed to fentanyl-related overdose are rising faster in Colorado than any other state with the exception of Alaska.

Democrats Play Political Football with Fentanyl Possession
* In 2019, with adoption of HB 19-1263, State Assembly Democrats ignored law enforcement recommendations and decreased incarceration rates when they reduced Fentanyl possession over four grams from a Felony to a Misdemeanor like a traffic ticket; thereby encouraging the epidemic that is currently devastating Colorado.
* By 2022, with a state-wide epidemic, HB 22-1326 was adopted, which allows possession of up to one gram a misdemeanor even though one gram is lethal to one person.
* Governor Polis signed HB 19-1263 which reduced Fentanyl from a Felony to a Misdemeanor and has currently agreed to sign HS 22-1326 allowing one gram of Fentanyl to REMAIN A MISTDEMEANOR CHARGE.

My commitment to YOU is to solve the Fentanyl Crisis and make Colorado a safe place to live, raise a family, and thrive!

Donate (https://www.lopez2022.com/donate?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=5565fbad7d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_05&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-5565fbad7d-584862049) or sign up to be a Game Changer (https://www.lopez2022.com/volunteer-1?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=5565fbad7d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_05&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-5565fbad7d-584862049) today to help me become the Governor to return security and safety to Colorado!

Sincerely,

Greg Lopez

*Mass-overdose events typically occur when drug dealers sell their product as “cocaine” when it actually contains fentanyl; or when drug dealers sell pills designed to appear to be legitimate prescriptions but are actually fake prescription pills containing fentanyl, creating a scenario where many overdose victims are dying after unknowingly ingesting fentanyl.
Find Out More (https://www.lopez2022.com/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=5565fbad7d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_05_16_05_05&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-5565fbad7d-584862049)

We are Coloradans who want to freely and responsibly live our best lives. We refuse to be told by so-called experts and politicians how we must live. Together, we can flip the power back to the people by electing a new governor that’s one of us, for all of us. [ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

We are reaching out to our members in North Carolina to vote on our first two endorsements of 2022 in the state!

First up, Erica Smith is running to represent North Carolina’s 1st District in Congress!

Senator Smith is a progressive running a corporate-free campaign against a conservative fellow State Senator who has too often voted with Republicans. She, on the other hand, has a record of taking on Big Energy, cash bail, and predatory lending as well as fighting to expand healthcare access, raise the minimum wage, and protect reproductive healthcare and our climate.

“We will come together, from small towns and farms across our district, to win this seat for the people and deliver a New Deal for rural North Carolinians,” Erica said. “We need a Rural New Deal that levels the playing field. Our communities deserve more than a GoFundMe healthcare system and a dollar store economy,” Erica said, advocating for a sustainable energy future that'll create millions of good paying jobs and secure energy freedom.

In Washington, Erica will fight for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and the PRO Act.

Nida Allam is running for Congress in North Carolina’s 4th District. She is an outspoken progressive who served as a political director for Bernie’s 2016 presidential campaign.

Nida currently serves on the Durham County Commission, where she voted to raise the minimum wage for county employees to $15/hour and led the charge for a low-income tax grant assistance program during the pandemic. She also worked to secure funding for a Refugee and Immigrant Services Coordinator for the district.
