# Thank you for your support!

Dear Friend,

I am so grateful to you for the opportunity to meet so many people from all over Pennsylvania and hearing about the issues that matter most to everyday people like you. Thank you for your support and confidence in me.

That’s why I am going to ask you to trust me once again when I tell you that the stakes are too high to split our vote this Republican Primary. The very reason I began this campaign is the same reason I have suspended my campaign: my desire to serve the people of Pennsylvania and their best interests. I am proud of our campaign and everything we accomplished. I am grateful to my family and friends, my campaign team, all of the volunteers and those of you who have supported me, encouraged me, prayed for me, and given so generously financially and of your time and talents - those of you I have known since I was a college Republican and those I just met, I am completely in awe of your kindness.

It has been the honor of a lifetime getting to know so many of you, and **_I ask that you join me TOMORROW as I vote for Lou Barletta_**. Lou has a record of winning in districts with a Democrat registration advantage and I believe he is the only candidate who can defeat Josh Shapiro in November.

It has been a pleasure to get to know Lou better on the campaign trail, and I know he shares our conservative values and will implement the vision many of us have laid out in our campaigns.

Yours Very Truly,

Melissa

Hello,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ **I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.**
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
**And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.**
This time, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.

clean_body: Hello, When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful. People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened. They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service. And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other. This time, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue. In order to be ready to fight back, we need to raise another $400,000 before our federally-mandated FEC fundraising deadline on Wednesday, but right now, we’re still falling pretty short. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to have the resources we need to win, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give right now: = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = All the Super PAC money in the world can’t defeat grassroots support from people like you. I’m so grateful to have you on the team, Mike Franken, VADM, U.S. Navy (ret.) Paid for by Michael Franken for Iowa, Inc Michael Franken for Iowa, Inc PO Box 13401 Des Moines, IA 50310 United States

WE DID IT!
Just a few short weeks after I announced my candidacy for Lieutenant Governor, our campaign has submitted more than 10,000 certified signatures to the Secretary of State, allowing me to qualify for the ballot.
I'd like to thank you for your support and for all you did to make this happen. We had volunteers spread out in cities and towns across the state collecting signatures for weeks. It was hard work, but we got it done before the deadline!
I decided to get into this race because I know Geoff Diehl and I represent the best ticket to help restore faith and confidence in our state's government. We will fight hard to keep your taxes low and protect your rights and freedoms. We believe in the importance of your child's education, and your right to make decisions about curriculum. And, as a nurse, I believe we are in the best position of any candidates to help shape our state's pandemic policies the right way.
With the MassGOP Convention now just days away, our campaign has amazing momentum and I believe we are poised for a great victory!
But, in order to get there, I continue to need your help.
If you stand with Geoff and me, would you please consider making a donation in support of my campaign today? Here's the link to donate online: [Support Leah! ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001uwsg8Y4bRR0YlMgIFICSOOtFU9ModEjpeFa4-EFYSnuVtXQCMVHN4BhWTob8Hn_G7TNVPZC_mClCoCDA9denaWLEHtyuem3BW7_XFYNy4Ya-fAltQ8tRhbCHeA2vG0H6Q4DkSeXBlUbTO4FVNLOMcAiT9OSRbXA052fM53-Tx5FZPiJDda-10g==&c=8yvhykYYNQgyvB-nSXb49s5tFu8-TmTvNfMpiuxDT701FEuhFVCJiw==&ch=OklfjQbmcwGQOo6fBtVUq8sS6FH_e2VRkJhabTVsKz6Qn0gkBYnK0g==)
And, if you are a delegate to the MassGOP Convention this weekend, I humbly ask for your vote to be your next Lieutenant Governor.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Geoff and I are in this race to win it, and I am confident that with your help, we will prevail.
Sincerely,
Leah Cole Allen

subject: It’s the heart of who we are

body:
[](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20220516_ad&n=1) | Hi Friend, Oregon’s homeless crisis is getting worse. People are dying and being killed on our streets. Politicians keep talking while tent cities grow in our neighborhoods and near our parks and schools. The status quo is hurting everyone. [](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/crisis?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20220516_ad&n=2) Homelessness is complex, but lack of leadership and bad policy choices are making it worse every day:
* Rampant access to illegal and newly legal drugs
* One of the worst mental health treatment systems in the nation
* A housing affordability crisis caused by housing supply crisis
* Failing to prioritize service-focused immediate shelters

As the people’s governor, I will lead to address homelessness with no-nonsense urgency. I will balance compassion with personal responsibility. Before I am sworn-in, I will bring together state and local officials to craft an **action plan with common-sense solutions** to address all aspects of the homeless crisis – addiction, drugs, better law enforcement, mental health, housing, and poverty. Upon taking office, I will immediately direct ODOT to begin cleaning up the garbage and trash pilling up along state highways. Oregon’s homeless crisis strikes at the heart of who we are. It won’t be solved by the same people doing the same things. We can get our mojo back – but not without a big change. For me, governor is not some steppingstone. I want to do things. Fix things. I want to make Oregon better for everyone. But to do that, we need a different kind of politics and leadership. We need to recapture our maverick, independent spirit and put the people back in charge. Don’t be a spectator. Sincerely,
Betsy

body:
Bryce Reeves Announces Endorsement by Delegate Mike Webert
| | | [](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fbrycereeves.com/1/01000180ceba34c4-788a2dba-4ecd-4c5d-a6f3-1bd7778d8ef5-000000/vaVgU3_Com-9Sgq9y_0kQzpBDgA=270)

| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: Jimmy Spinellamedia@brycereeves.com **Bryce Reeves Announces Endorsement by Delegate Mike Webert** **FREDERICKSBURG, VA – May 16, 2022 – **Today, Senator Bryce Reeves (R-Spotsylvania) announced a new endorsement for his campaign in the 7th Congressional District, by Delegate Mike Webert (R-Fauquier). Delegate Webert joins a long list of conservative General Assembly members, who represent the new 7th District, getting behind the Reeves campaign. Delegate Webert said, “I’m happy to endorse Bryce Reeves in the 7th Congressional District, because he is the conservative we need to defeat Abigail Spanberger. Bryce has been a consistent leader in protecting and fighting for our constitutional rights in Richmond. Now, more than ever, we need someone in Washington who will stand for our principles, and I know Bryce is best person to do it.” Bryce Reeves stated, “I'm honored to have the support of a conservative warrior like Delegate Webert. Unlike Abigail Spanberger, I am ready to go to Washington and stand up for our constitutional rights day in and day out. It's time to fight, lead, and win so that we can take back the 7th District, and the House of Representatives this year." Delegate Mike Webert represents the 18th House of Delegates district. It includes Rappahannock county, as well as parts of Warren, Fauquier, and Culpeper counties, the latter of which is in the 7th Congressional District. Delegate Webert is a noted Constitutional conservative, and consistently leads the way in the House of Delegates on issues including the Second Amendment and Agriculture. Delegate Webert joins many other members of the General Assembly in supporting Bryce Reeves' in his run for Congress. They supporters include Del. Margaret Ransone (R-Westmoreland), Del. Bobby Orrock (R-Caroline), Del. Rob Bell (R-Albemarle), Del. Nick Freitas (R-Culpeper), Del. Tara Durant (R-Stafford), Del. Phillip Scott (R-Spotsylvania), Senator Richard Stuart (R-Westmoreland) former Del. Mark Dudenhefer (R-Stafford) and former Speaker Bill Howell (R-Stafford). Other key endorsements for the Reeves campaign include U.S. Senators Mike Lee (R-Utah) and Marco Rubio (R-Florida) as well as other national groups and leaders including former Secretary of Energy Rick Perry, former Governor Bob McDonnell, former Governor and US Senator George Allen, SEAL PAC, GOPAC, and FreedomWorks. Prominent activists in Virginia like Paul Galanti and Pete Snyder have also endorsed Reeves in the 7th District race. Bryce Reeves has also received many endorsements from the law enforcement community both nationally and locally. Nationally, he has received support from Tom Homan, who served as Director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) under President Trump from 2017-2018 , as well as Tony Pham, who was Acting Director of ICE under President Trump in 2020. Locally, sheriffs from the 7th Congressional District supporting Reeves in this campaign include Sheriff Jenkins (Culpeper), Sheriff Decatur (Stafford), Sheriff Lippa (Caroline), Sheriff Higgs (Fredericksburg), Sheriff Giles (King George), Sheriff Harris (Spotsylvania) and Sheriff Amos (Orange). Bryce has also received endorsements from Sheriffs outside the district, including those in Chesterfield, Louisa, and Montgomery counties. In addition, Commonwealth Attorney Travis Bird of Spotsylvania has thrown his support behind Senator Reeves. ### Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff’s deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is the Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Senator Reeves resides in Spotsylvania County.

Unlike Abigail Spanberger, I am ready to go to Washington and stand up for our constitutional rights day in and day out. It's time to fight, lead, and win so that we can take back the 7th District, and the House of Representatives this year." Delegate Mike Webert represents the 18th House of Delegates district. It includes Rappahannock county, as well as parts of Warren, Fauquier, and Culpeper counties, the latter of which is in the 7th Congressional District. Delegate Webert is a noted Constitutional conservative, and consistently leads the way in the House of Delegates on issues including the Second Amendment and Agriculture. Delegate Webert joins many other members of the General Assembly in supporting Bryce Reeves' in his run for Congress. They supporters include Del. Margaret Ransone (R-Westmoreland), Del. Bobby Orrock (R-Caroline), Del. Rob Bell (R-Albemarle), Del. Nick Freitas (R-Culpeper), Del. Tara Durant (R-Stafford), Del. Phillip Scott (R-Spotsylvania), Senator Richard Stuart (R-Westmoreland) former Del. Mark Dudenhefer (R-Stafford) and former Speaker Bill Howell (R-Stafford). Other key endorsements for the Reeves campaign include U.S. Senators Mike Lee (R-Utah) and Marco Rubio (R-Florida) as well as other national groups and leaders including former Secretary of Energy Rick Perry, former Governor Bob McDonnell, former Governor and US Senator George Allen, SEAL PAC, GOPAC, and FreedomWorks. Prominent activists in Virginia like Paul Galanti and Pete Snyder have also endorsed Reeves in the 7th District race. Bryce Reeves has also received many endorsements from the law enforcement community both nationally and locally. Nationally, he has received support from Tom Homan, who served as Director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) under President Trump from 2017-2018 , as well as Tony Pham, who was Acting Director of ICE under President Trump in 2020. Locally, sheriffs from the 7th Congressional District supporting Reeves in this campaign include Sheriff Jenkins (Culpeper), Sheriff Decatur (Stafford), Sheriff Lippa (Caroline), Sheriff Higgs (Fredericksburg), Sheriff Giles (King George), Sheriff Harris (Spotsylvania) and Sheriff Amos (Orange). Bryce has also received endorsements from Sheriffs outside the district, including those in Chesterfield, Louisa, and Montgomery counties. In addition, Commonwealth Attorney Travis Bird of Spotsylvania has thrown his support behind Senator Reeves. ### Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff’s deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is the Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [This is the Year](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziorBqym8hMtSVf8hZQhqPRhXHUTYc_l5zYR3crCxJD2S-w&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=1) The bill removing parental consent for 12-year-olds to get vaccinated has passed the Senate by a single vote. You can see the final tally [here](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TvaGE_dL30m3umomz1M9lIixlS9cZ0kYt-9W2kAhoC1WiP0rzWBGB-NyGVUkKJyvlg&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=2). As appalling as that is, I’m confident we’ll stop this obscene legislation in the Assembly. Meanwhile, Gavin Newsom just announced a $300 billion budget. Twenty years ago, it was $100 billion. And everything has gotten worse. This spectacular failure of “progressive” politics is becoming intolerable to even the most left-leaning Californians. In San Francisco, they ousted their school board members in a landslide and are about to do the same to their DA. It's another sign this is the year we can change things. Here a few voting recommendations:
* **My Successor** : My Assembly District has been split in half, so I get to endorse two successors: [Joe Patterson](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=5x_oC7N6aI_RpCQhAiwSbgpfobf228Vm_yKsWD_IbbY&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=3) and [Josh Hoover](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=FqASoaRdWAd2xBPgmnxWIu6eiV0SRACd9gyGauSvnlA&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=4). Both are true fighters.

* **Governor** : I have not yet endorsed a candidate. Leading contenders are Shawn Collins, Jenny Rae Le Roux, Brian Dahle, Anthony Trimino, Michael Shellenberger.

* **State Controller** : [Lanhee Chen](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JPwWv9sQplLiIxxyZfevGStRFPNVd7Nmibye6gtdwZc&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=5) will be a fiscal watchdog to rein in the Supermajority.

* **State Superintendent** : [Lance Christensen](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=igqQa2OpQ5fjyOnNh2Xg65lA3CmAzSKm_R0ntyLoYBE&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=6) is running to oust an incumbent who is entirely controlled by the teachers unions.

* **Other Offices** : See the CA Republican Party’s [endorsements](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=pVpJJiUBpvQT0yrTAoNeOhpJu7Pk2SmDd_wN2e23Mp5D4AsJTXn-1CMwpozrpOpv&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=7) and Carl DeMaio’s Reform California [Voter Guide](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=9QSW_r7SuJy773fFZ4YxBI0MLMItGTfEikdPecqg1e2fsmK-Seyb195yd5a5H8_8SHpMAyucupoOCF6c_Dk99FzGkpJPoT4HhZ4mX03XoyCT8ahejhOG6me3OVKxkcxT&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=8).

I’m running for the 3rd Congressional District. It covers 10 counties, but I’m grateful to have loyal supporters from every part of California. I want to be a voice in Congress for all California conservatives and patriots. Because I know that you believe, as I do, that California is worth fighting for and America is worth saving. Election Day is in 3 weeks. [Help us win](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may16_final&n=9). # This Week's Events
May 16 - May 20
2022 Primary Election Day is Tomorrow! Registered voters in North Carolina may vote at their assigned polling place. This is different than early voting, where eligible individuals may cast a ballot at any early voting site in their county.

Polling places will be open from 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. Find your Election Day polling place by entering your information into the [Voter Search](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=a250932c83&e=20ac8f046f) or search using your address with the [Election Day Polling Place Search.](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=23b32e7b2c&e=20ac8f046f)

If you voted by absentee ballot, remember you can return your ballot to your local County Board of Elections by 5 pm tomorrow to be counted.

If you voted early, you can track the status of your early vote or Mail-in ballot by using [BallotTrax](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=789940e564&e=20ac8f046f).

Click [HERE](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=ba0cb78e3a&e=20ac8f046f) to RSVP.

Please write checks to "**Boys & Girls Clubs of Durham and Orange Counties**." You can mail the check to my PO Box at: **PO Box 995, Hillsborough, NC 27278**.

subject: This is it, Derek
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
hey Derek it’s John.
greetings from Lancaster General hospital 👋
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220516-2?refcode=em20220516-5854&refcode2=5854_434096_37alU7&akid=5854%2E434096%2E37alU7)
I’m reaching out right now for two reasons (but I’m typing this on my iPhone from the hospital so please, forgive any typos)
1 because I wanted to make sure you heard it from me that i am a-okay. Im glad i listened to Gisele (even if she’ll never let me hear the end of it 🙄).
The doctors and nurses here at Lancaster General are absolutely incredible and i cannot thank them enough.
2\. Tomorrow is our primary election. In just over 12 hours from now, the polls will open and pennsylvanians across our great commonwealth will make their voices heard.
So here are my final thoughts as we head into our last sleep before the day we’ve been working towards .
i could not be more proud of every single person on this team.
Our staff + 1000s of volunteers. My best girl Gisele + our kids. This campaign is SO, so much bigger than me. This is about our Commonwealth. A future we all share.
Not to mention YOU, Derek. we wouldn’t be here without you. Seriously.
the campaign u helped us build has been historic in so many ways + tomorrow we hope to make history again by becoming the *official* Democratic nominee for US Senate.
that doesn’t mean we’re slowing down though. our team always sprints THROUGH the finish line, not TO it.
**[so, can you make your first donation before the polls open tomorrow morning at 7am to help fund our Election Day GOTV efforts? Your donation will help us turn out as many voters as possible before polls close.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220516-2?refcode=em20220516-5854&refcode2=5854_434096_37alU7&akid=5854%2E434096%2E37alU7)**
Here’s that link one more time, Derek: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220516-2?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220516-2?refcode=em20220516-5854&refcode2=5854_434096_37alU7&akid=5854%2E434096%2E37alU7)**
well, Derek. i dont think there’s anything else left to say except: thank you, thank you, THANK YOU!!! ❤️❤️❤️
let’s win this thing.
—John

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRY FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/russellfrysc/palmetto-post?e=7aa6ac5965)

---
| | [**Tom Rice lied: Russell Fry did not ‘miss’ 600 votes as a state representative**](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=9bf3533659&e=7aa6ac5965)

Florence, S.C. — How is it possible that Russell Fry failed to show up for 600 votes during his seven years as a state representative like Tom Rice claimed during a raucous congressional debate here recently for the 7th District seat? Because according to the attendance report from the South Carolina House of Representatives, Fry has only missed six days of session total, and three of those days were the year his son was born. In other words, Fry has a 98% attendance record. “The attacks from Russell’s opponents during the debate were baseless,” said State Rep. Heather Ammons Crawford (R-Socastee). “I sit next to Russell Fry in the SC House and he doesn’t miss work. I know when he gets to Washington, he will display a strong work ethic and defend our conservative values just as he has done in Columbia.” Fry didn’t _miss_ all these votes, _he recused himself _from those votes and Rice knew that when he launched his debate attack and began flooding the airwaves across the Grand Strand and Pee Dee region in an expensive TV ad buy that only Rice could afford. South Carolina requires state elected officials to recuse themselves from voting on any spending bills or legislation that does, or could pose, a conflict of interest with the lawmaker’s job or business, or any member of their family’s business. He did not miss more than 600 votes. Fry, like every member of the General Assembly, recuses himself from numerous votes a year because he was advised by the Ethics Committee to avoid those votes out of an abundance of caution that it might constitute a conflict of interest. That may still seem like a lot of votes, but the House casts hundreds of votes just in a single week when passing the budget. On the recent bill banning CRT from being taught in South Carolina classrooms, nearly 100 votes were taken just to finalize that measure. Fry should wear it as a badge of honor that he follows the Ethics Committee recommendations and declines to vote on legislation that could create a conflict of interest. If only members of Congress practiced the same standards of moral and ethics and recused themselves from votes that inflates their stock portfolios, pads their pockets, or gives them special tax breaks. For instance, Congressman Tom Rice voted on budgets for the FBI that paid his company rental payments over years totaling approximately $500,000. That’s the sort of conflict of interest Fry avoids. Tom Rice knows he’s spinning a lie with the missed votes myth, but he doesn’t care because he’s at serious risk of losing the 7th District Congressional seat he’s held since it was created after the 2010 census. Rice has raised millions of dollars to win reelection, and has money to burn in political ads attacking Fry for this falsehood and others that are sure to come. In a mail piece sent to Republican voters recently, Rice proved that once again he cannot be trusted when he says, “Fry doesn’t bother to show up in Columbia.” Fry was the clear winner of the Florence debate as he exhibited a strong knowledge of the issues, confirmed his consistent conservative record on critical votes, and proved he has the ethical and moral courage to avoid getting entangled in conflicts of interest. If this is the hill Tom Rice wants to die on, then remember when you go to the polls and vote on election day that Russell Fry recuses himself from multiple votes a year because it could become a conflict of interest and it would be unethical to do so. And Rice is attacking him for doing the right thing.

## May 19th Meet & Greet with Derrick Gates
---
---
|
---
# May 19th Meet and Greet with CRA Endorsed Congressional Candidate for the 36th District (former 33rd) Derrick Gates and several other exciting speakers. Come get some great food and find out how you can help save California and the Nation. 7pm Pyramid Office & Medical Park 22939 Hawthorne Blvd, Torrance
[CLICK TO LEARN MORE ABOUT DERRICK](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=27098.52.1.1a9eacff6602acc6dea345d7ba4def4f)
## May 20th LA County-wide CRA candidate Forum.

---

|
---
# **Cordie Williams for US Senate**
Dr. Cordie Williams is a former United States Marine and has built a successful chiropractic business in San Diego County with his wife Dr. Tania Williams. Dr. Williams co-founded an organization as an expression of his desire to protect Californians’ right to make important decisions for themselves and their families due to the pandemic eroding freedom to make individual choices. Therefore, the time is now to elect leaders who have more faith in the citizenry than in government.
Cordie Williams will be challenging controversial appointed incumbent Alex Padilla in the June 2022 Open California Primary Election. Vice President Kamala Harris held the seat prior to the 2020 election.
[Click to visit Cordie website](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=27098.53.1.d509453ba1a287f7c3b22289bc0dcb9d)
|
---
# Derrick Gates for US Congress CA-36
Derrick has 15 years of experience in corporate mediation, revitalizing churches, starting ministries, equipping leaders, and helping the less fortunate around the United States.
Derrick has conservative values and an ability to see them reestablished in our communities.
Derrick Mentors multicultural leaders from around the United States.
Derrick desires to raise Bold, Moral, Men, and Women of Integrity to lead our country. [Learn More](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=27098.54.1.f9b36a1d336dc0943aae7f1e855d9bdc)
|
---
# Eric Early for CA Attorney General
Eric Early is a husband, father, small businessman and attorney who is running for California Attorney General in 2022.
In the 2020 election cycle, Eric came in the top two in the June 2020 Primary, becoming the official Republican candidate against Adam Schiff for Congress for California’s 28th Congressional District. His great campaign was fueled by thousands of volunteers and supporters from around the country. Before that, in the 2018 election cycle, Eric entered his first campaign for public office running against Xavier Becerra for California Attorney General and received almost 1 million votes statewide.
Eric is the co-owner and Managing Partner of a 25 lawyer nationally recognized law firm which litigates in courts throughout America, handling constitutional, contract, fraud, real estate and general business disputes. [Learn More](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=27098.55.1.dad1dbaef7d877fa9ded731d8b10c711)
|
---
# Jack M. Guerrero CA Treasurer
Jack Guerrero brings a unique combination of public and private sector experience, with a quintessential American story. Jack’s experience as Mayor, City Councilmember, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Stanford economics graduate, Harvard MBA, Bank Vice President, Treasury professional, auditor of municipalities and government agencies, investment banker, and M&A due diligence advisor to Fortune 500 companies (with professional stints in New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, London, and Zurich) – establishes him as the candidate with BOTH Treasury experience AND a public service record of fighting for taxpayers and working people. [Learn More](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/436516?id=27098.56.1.462ee2670eb91d3f24f3ba9ca458e264)
|

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Insider News from the Political Revolution!

------------------------------------------------------------
HEADLINES: Nina vs. SuperPACS | New Endorsements! Amy Vilela - Brittany Ramos DeBarros - Summer Lee | Bernie Calls Out Biden | Ro Khanna | NY Health Act | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1011&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

Today, workers around the world celebrate May Day — the International Workers’ Day established by labor activists in 1889 to commemorate the Haymarket Massacre in Chicago and the struggle for an eight-hour working day.

Witnesses testified that none of the eight workers charged threw the bomb in Haymarket Square. Labor leader August Spies said: “I knew from the experience of the past that this butchering of people was done for the express purpose of defeating the eight-hour movement.”

Spies showed solidarity with his comrades through the trial, appeals, and at the gallows. Today, we mark the sacrifice and perseverance of workers striving for justice.

Become a member of Our Revolution, and receive your commemorative MAY DAY STICKER today! (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5451?t=1012&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ)

★ ★ ★

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1013&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

Join us this Tuesday at 8:30p ET/7:30 CT for a special Our Revolution Town Hall to Defend Democracy with our partners at Free Speech for People and lay out our campaign to bar insurrectionists from the ballot.

We’ll speak with courageous Our Revolution members - and their legal team - taking the fight directly to far-right extremists like Marjorie Taylor-Greene. And, we’re recruiting progressive patriots across the country to get engaged in this fight!

RSVP HERE (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5409?t=1014&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ)

★ ★ ★

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1015&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

★ ★ ★

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1016&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

OUR REVOLUTION vs. SUPER PACS

Billionaires and oil barons are lining up to line the pockets of our candidates’ opponents in the primaries. They’re funneling millions and millions into SuperPACs like DMFI, AIPAC, and now the new, “Mainstream Democrats PAC” to try to stop progressives from taking power.

Working-class fighters like Nina Turner, Rep. Andy Levin, David Segal, and Jessica Cisneros are being targeted with expensive smear campaigns from every direction. But, we have their back, and we know that M4A, a living wage, and climate action are the true mainstream positions of the people in this country.

The corporate establishment knows what’s at stake in these races, and so do we. That’s why we mobilized our ground game early and are waging the fight in each of these pivotal races.

Our candidates rely on the power of the movement — campaigns funded by small-dollar donations and fueled by our boots on the ground. Join our Phonebank Force (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1017&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ) to connect with voters and help drown out corporate money.

★ ★ ★

The primaries are heating up, and we have some truly phenomenal candidates on the ballot – organizers, teachers, and diverse working-class fighters – stepping forward to lead with our movement. Become a Movement Builder today to help progressives seize the levers of power from corporate Dems. (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/or-newsletter-22&amount=10&refcode=OR_EM_NEWS_1MO_20220509_1_1&recurring=true?t=1018&refcode2=2906_5885482_bF2VUJ&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ)

★ ★ ★

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1019&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

NINA TURNER FOR CONGRESS - ROUND 2
THE HOMESTRETCH

Folks, this is not a drill —
This is our chance to elect Nina Turner to Congress!

Election Day is Tuesday and in-person early voting is happening right now! So far, turnout is low, so every vote we get for Nina will really COUNT!

If you know someone in Greater Cleveland, help them get out to vote before 7:30 pm Tuesday at Cuyahoga County Board of Elections, 2925 Euclid Ave.

“The energy on the ground is palpable!” Nina told us. “Now is the time to maximize our efforts together.”

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1020&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

This is one of the most consequential primaries of 2022 — and the billionaires know it. But, our movement is rising up against the BIG money trying to buy this seat. As Nina says, “All that we love is on the line, and Cleveland is not for sale!”

As Katrina vanden Heuvel wrote in The Washington Post (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5452?t=1021&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ) , noting Our Revolution’s support for Nina: “The contest has come to represent a battle for the soul of the party.”

“Turner’s election to Congress would provide progressives with a skilled, dedicated, and powerful reformer, an inside ally for the progressive movement that is driving the change vital to this nation’s democracy and security,” she stated.

“Change will take place only if citizens organize to force it — both with movements that drive the debate and with leaders such as Nina Turner who frame the issues and help lead the fight,” says Heuvel. We wholeheartedly agree.

NINA & THE FIGHT FOR M4A

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1022&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

Nina has been in the trenches with Our Revolution for Medicare for All since Day 1, and on Thursday, we hosted a fundraiser for her centering around just that.

“The commodification of healthcare in America is not by accident. It’s inhumane and cruel,” Nina said. “I won’t get any peace until we get Medicare for All, and I won’t let anyone else get any peace either.”

Our Revolution National Organizing Coordinator Anna-Marta Visky spoke on the call about our work to grow cosponsors for federal legislation and pass M4A Resolutions in cities in Nina’s district.

“This work is paying off big time,” Anna Marta said. “Lakewood and Cleveland Heights have passed M4A Resolutions. Talking one-on-one with folks results in a more engaged voter base, and we’re excited to see them early vote for Nina!”

Healthcare justice advocate Michael Lighty said, “Our Revolution walks the walk and that embodies what Nina and the Medicare for All movement are all about.”

“They would not be spending this kind of money if the other side wasn’t losing — we can win, and our win will have a ripple effect for other candidates across the country,” Nina said.

This is a new day and a new district — which includes all of Cleveland, where Nina won by 10 points, and neighborhoods like Lakewood that went for Bernie twice! We can bring this home if we put in the work. Let’s go!

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1023&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

Nina isn’t taking a DIME from special interests or corrupt SuperPACs, which means she’s counting on us to power this final push and get out the vote.

So far, 150 Our Revolution volunteers have made 60k phone calls and sent 40k texts and 330k emails connecting with voters for Nina.

Help us reach even more folks up through the end of voting Tuesday night! With low voter turnout, the calls you make to get progressives to the polls could get Nina over the finish line.

VOLUNTEER FOR NINA (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4901?t=1024&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ)

★ ★ ★

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5450?t=1025&akid=2906%2E5885482%2EbF2VUJ

As one of our movement’s fiercest champions for Medicare for All, Our Revolution is honored to endorse Amy Vilela for Congress in Nevada’s 1st District.

Amy served as Nevada Co-Chair for Bernie Sanders’ 2020 campaign, and now she’s taking on a corporate-backed Democratic incumbent for this pivotal Vegas seat.

“I am running to represent the working class,” Amy told us on our National Organizing Call on Monday. “This is the right race at the right time, and stakeholders on the frontlines want a seat at the table.”

Amy’s politics and progressive values are deeply rooted in her lived experience. Raised in poverty, experiencing homelessness, and becoming a first-generation college graduate — she knows the struggle firsthand. Amy and her husband thought they were beating the odds to build their American Dream when tragedy struck in 2015.

VOLUNTEER FOR AMY () ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution and Our Revolution-NY Progressive Action Network are backing Brittany Ramos DeBarros for Congress in NY-11! Brittany is an Afro-Latina Staten Islander, community organizer, former Army captain, and anti-war activist running a bold campaign to empower working people in her community. “I feel for our people in my bones, and nothing could stop me from standing up boldly about the truth of that suffering and a vision of a future we know is entirely possible,” Brittany said on our National Organizing Call () on Monday. The Amazon Labor Union drives are right in her district, and Brittany said she’s proud to help them organize. “These workers have the kind of grit it’s going to take to have a powerful, organized working class for a real revolution of values in this country.” Brittany grew up in a conservative, military family, believing the American ‘bootstraps’ story — though they struggled and she went to college on an Army scholarship. “Once I deployed to Afghanistan as a platoon leader responsible for 40 lives, I saw corporations were running the show,” she said. “Nobody should have to carry a gun - potentially killing and dying - just to afford an education.” Medicare for All and a Green New Deal are two of her top priorities. “I'm fighting alongside my community for dignity, for housing justice, economic justice, racial justice, and criminal justice reform,” Brittany said. In the primary, she’s up against conservative former Democratic Rep. Max Rose, who lost the seat in 2020 to GOP Nicole Malliotakis. The incumbent supported the Jan. 6th rioters and calls herself the “right-wing answer to The Squad.” If you’re in NY-11, you can apply for your absentee ballot now to vote in the June 28th Democratic Primary. Click here to get started () ! “This race is a huge opportunity,” Brittany said Monday. “We have the people-power on our side. If we put in that groundwork, we will win this and we will make history.” We hope you’ll help Our Revolution ramp up our ground game to give candidates like Brittany a decisive edge. Your calls will make a huge impact in this district! SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER () ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution is thrilled to endorse Summer Lee for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 12th District! Summer worked as a labor organizer with the Fight for $15, organizing to protect worker rights, and went on to lead voter mobilization efforts to strengthen our democracy. In 2018, she made history as the first Black woman from Western PA ever elected to the state legislature. Throughout her time in office, State Rep. Lee has been a voice for working families and an ally of Our Revolution. “Organizing is the center of my work. It’s where I come from and it’s integral to how I serve in office,” Summer said on our National Organizing Call () on Monday. “As legislators, we have platforms and some resources, but when we use them to organize people on the outside — that’s a powerful movement right there,” she said. In Congress, she’ll be a champion for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, voting rights, and taking on corporate power to restore the voice of the people in our democracy. “The number one support for lazy incumbency is low voter turnout and voter suppression. If they can keep working people home, they can stay in their seats serving corporate America forever,” Summer said. “We’re expanding the electorate, connecting people to their own power, and we’re changing the political landscape.” Rep. Lee has been endorsed by Bernie Sanders and Our Revolution Pennsylvania. Help us elect progressive allies like Summer to make democracy work for all of us. ★ ★ ★ Join thousands of Our Revolution volunteers to elect working-class fighters like Amy Vilela, Brittany Ramos DeBarros, Summer Lee, and of course Nina Turner! We must replace the enemies of progress in Congress with strong movement partners. Our Revolution Volunteer Taylor Pinckney told us how good it feels when our efforts pay off. While she was phone banking, a voter a voter mentioned that her call and a mailer from Our Revolution helped him switch from a centrist candidate to Erica Smith for Congress in NC-1. “He thanked us for opening his eyes that Erica was the most progressive candidate and said that’s what his district needs,” Taylor told us. “It was cool to see the impact — when I make these connections with voters, it motivates me to keep the work going.” If you have just one hour a week, you can make a difference, too! Our crew will be there every step of the way to help you make calls, earn rewards, and tip the balance of power! JOIN THE FORCE! () ★ ★ ★ BERNIE ENDORSES NIDA ALLAM Our Revolution is backing Nida Allam for Congress in North Carolina’s 4th district — and, now it’s official, Bernie is too! “Nida Allam knows that it takes a true grassroots movement to defeat big money special interests and deliver real change for working people,” Bernie said. “Together in Congress, we will fight for the working class by standing up for M4A, GND, and a living wage.” Nida was political director for Bernie’s 2016 presidential campaign and currently serves on the Durham County Commission. The first Muslim woman ever elected to public office in North Carolina, she voted to raise the minimum wage for county employees to a living wage. ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ BERNIE STANDS WITH WORKERS, CALLS ON BIDEN TO ACT! This weekend, Our Revolution joined Bernie and AOC as they hit the road to rally with workers fighting to unionize against some of the most powerful corporate forces on Earth. On Sunday afternoon, Bernie addressed () Amazon Labor Union ahead of their 2nd union election at the LDJ5 facility in Staten Island. By evening, he was speaking to a crowd at a concert () for Starbucks Workers United in Richmond, Va. On Tuesday, Bernie was live on the Senate floor () calling out Amazon’s “illegal anti-union tactics” and calling on President Biden to issue an executive order prohibiting any company that engages in union-busting from getting federal government contracts, Reuters () reports. “Amazon is the poster child for why this anti-union busting Executive Order is needed,” Bernie said. “President Biden, you promised to prevent union-busters like Amazon from receiving lucrative contracts from the federal government. Keep that promise.” Rumors of Bernie 2024 are circulating, but the truth is — Our Revolution and the progressive movement are doing the work today to build the worker power we need to forge a better future. It takes labor power, organizers like us, and elected allies all lifting together to advance our progressive mission forward. Bernie lit the match and he’s still out here with us. Become a movement builder today to help carry the torch. () ★ ★ ★ Today, workers around the world celebrate May Day — the International Workers’ Day established by labor activists in 1889 to commemorate the Haymarket Massacre in Chicago and the struggle for an eight-hour working day. Witnesses testified that none of the eight workers charged threw the bomb in Haymarket Square. Labor leader August Spies said: “I knew from the experience of the past that this butchering of people was done for the express purpose of defeating the eight-hour movement.” Spies showed solidarity with his comrades through the trial, appeals, and at the gallows. Today, we mark the sacrifice and perseverance of workers striving for justice. Become a member of Our Revolution, and receive your commemorative MAY DAY STICKER today! () ★ ★ ★ LARRY COHEN ON THE LABOR FIGHT Our Revolution Board Chair Larry Cohen, a lifelong labor leader, joined our National Organizing Call () on Monday to dig into the rise of worker organizing. “This is an exciting time — not only at Amazon and Starbucks, but there’s all kinds of organizing at workplaces across the country. The first Apple retail store joined my union CWA,” Larry said. “This is organizing from the bottom up, and that’s what we believe in here at Our Revolution.” Why now? Larry told Aaron White of Open Democracy () that “fueled by inflation, the pandemic and a shortage of people to do these jobs, working-class people are much more confident and not willing to just take whatever is thrown at them.” ★ ★ ★ RO KHANNA TALKS POLICY FIGHTS Also on our latest National Organizing Call () , Our Revolution Board Chair Larry Cohen asked US Rep. Ro Khanna about legislation to end taxpayer subsidies to the fossil fuel industry. “Greta Thunberg testified and said it would be a gut punch for Democrats to have both chambers and the presidency and not repeal fossil fuel subsidies,” Ro told him. “And, she’s right. This is something we can and must do.” To Larry’s inquiry into Biden’s Billionaires Tax, Ro said: “There are a lot more working class and middle-class folks than billionaires, and they rightly resent the fact that they’re not paying their fair share. Instead, they take loans against their values and never realize the capital gains.” Ro also spoke on the need for Democrats to deliver to strengthen democracy. “Folks don’t believe the promises anymore,” he said. “They watch presidents and congresses come and go, and their lives are worse — decades of off-shoring jobs, towns shrinking, kids moving away. We need a systemic policy for economic revitalization in this country.” Larry agreed, saying: “Ro helps us build Our Revolution and build this outside political pressure we need. Now, it’s time to get more allies for the Ro Khannas in Congress.” ★ ★ ★ FIGHTING FOR HEALTHCARE IN NY On Tuesday, Our Revolution joined Campaign for NY Health and other groups in Albany for a Day of Action calling on the state to pass the NY Health Act to provide universal healthcare to every New Yorker and end medical debt. Organizers, activists, labor leaders, and legislators all came together to march, rally, and speak in one voice to demand New York electeds prioritize healthcare justice before they go on recess on June 2 to campaign for re-election. Our Revolution NY Organizing Coordinator Jennyfer Almanzar spoke to attendees at the rally: “Every New Yorker — and every person in America — deserves full healthcare and to be free from the burden of medical costs. Our lives are on the line.” Become a member of Our Revolution to help us continue this fight in New York and across the country. Every step towards Medicare for All is a step toward healthcare justice. () ★ ★ ★ 2022 MEMBERSHIP DRIVE KICKOFF! To show our gratitude to members joining at higher donation levels, we’re sweetening the deal! For $10 a month, we’ll throw in our sticker 6-pack, and at $15, you’ll get the stickers and a poster. We need to talk about reproductive rights in Texas.

Our state has been making headlines around abortion access over the past couple of years -- and not for the right reasons.

The 6 week abortion law bans abortion before most people even know they are pregnant and disproportionately harms the most vulnerable Texans: people of color, immigrants, low-income, and young people.

[**TX-15 needs a representative who will fight for reproductive care in South Texas in the face of the most restrictive anti-abortion laws in the country. Will you split a donation between our campaign and Voter Protection Project now to make sure that we can get Michelle in office to fight for us?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/11913?t=7&akid=2481%2E878179%2EtSm8k0) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Michelle Vallejo and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/11914?t=8&akid=2481%2E878179%2EtSm8k0)

McAllen, TX, right here in our district, is home to the last remaining abortion clinic on the Texas-Mexico border.

People who need an abortion after 6 weeks are left with two options -- travel hundreds of miles to the nearest out-of-state clinic in New Mexico, or take a short day trip across the border to get care in Mexico.

**Listen, no one should have to cross a border to get medical care -- whether you need antibiotics, braces, or an abortion, you shouldn't have to leave the country to get affordable care.**

This is a travesty. South Texas needs someone in office that we can count on to do something about it -- to fight for our rights to safe, affordable healthcare, including abortion.

[**Michelle is the only reproductive rights candidate in this race. Split a $5 donation between our campaign and Voter Protection Project now to help us make sure we elect a pro-choice representative for TX-15.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/11913?t=13&akid=2481%2E878179%2EtSm8k0)

| | Dear Burril For Congress Team,

Primary voting is TOMORROW. Because of your financial support, prayers and willingness to meet, listen and tell your friends and family about Matthew Burril, _**we are in this race.**_
---
|
---
---
| Folks, we knew this was going to be a complex campaign with a lot of miles to cover. But this Congressional race has become more than that...it has become a national story! The amount of money thrown in by the Washington and Raleigh Political Action Committees alone exceeds a million dollars. And that's just on the Republican side!

You have been so gracious and eager to meet me and take my calls for the entire campaign. You are ready for reliable Conservative leadership by a Congressman who will remember who you are. You want someone who will listen to you without the filter of "What's in it for me?"

Thank you for all you have said and done for me in this campaign. It will be a pleasure to represent you in Congress.

**I WILL be a Better Congressman for you! **

Peter, **My campaign for Governor made it to the sixth ballot at the Minnesota Republican Convention this weekend, and I want to thank all my supporters, delegates, volunteers, staff, and donors for joining me on the journey. As President Trump said the best is yet to come, and you haven 't seen the last of me.** At the convention, my endorsement went to Scott Jensen and I have no regrets. Our end goal is to have Republicans governing Minnesota and I believe Scott is the best candidate alongside Matt Birk to beat Tim Walz. We cannot afford a long-drawn-out primary race or party infighting any longer. I am calling on everyone to unify with one common goal and that is to unseat the Democrats from governing at every level across Minnesota. The endeavor to represent the state of Minnesota as an America First Governor was a journey I will never forget and that is because of the friendships, colleagues, and partners who fought in the trenches alongside me to reclaim our state from the destructive grip of Radical Left Democrats. The memories and new friends I have made along this journey are something money can’t buy and I sincerely thank everyone for their support, especially my wife and daughter.

|
---

|
---
Now we must carry on in the charge of restoring our state to commonsense governance by supporting a leader who will uphold Conservative values unwaveringly.
Thank you for the incredible support of your time, efforts, and generosity which demonstrated a vote of confidence in my campaign! I look forward to continuing the fight of saving our nation from the Left’s radical agenda alongside all American patriots and flipping the state of Minnesota RED!

|
---
God Bless Minnesota,

|
---

|
---
**Mike Murphy****Mayor of Lexington**

clean_body: Our America First journey continues | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter, My campaign for Governor made it to the sixth ballot at the Minnesota Republican Convention this weekend, and I want to thank all my supporters, delegates, volunteers, staff, and donors for joining me on the journey. As President Trump said the best is yet to come, and you haven 't seen the last of me. At the convention, my endorsement went to Scott Jensen and I have no regrets. Our end goal is to have Republicans governing Minnesota and I believe Scott is the best candidate alongside Matt Birk to beat Tim Walz. We cannot afford a long-drawn-out primary race or party infighting any longer. I am calling on everyone to unify with one common goal and that is to unseat the Democrats from governing at every level across Minnesota. The endeavor to represent the state of Minnesota as an America First Governor was a journey I will never forget and that is because of the friendships, colleagues, and partners who fought in the trenches alongside me to reclaim our state from the destructive grip of Radical Left Democrats. The memories and new friends I have made along this journey are something money can’t buy and I sincerely thank everyone for their support, especially my wife and daughter. | | Now we must carry on in the charge of restoring our state to commonsense governance by supporting a leader who will uphold Conservative values unwaveringly. Thank you for the incredible support of your time, efforts, and generosity which demonstrated a vote of confidence in my campaign! I look forward to continuing the fight of saving our nation from the Left’s radical agenda alongside all American patriots and flipping the state of Minnesota RED! | God Bless Minnesota, | | Mike MurphyMayor of Lexington | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | PREPARED AND PAID FOR BY MIKE MURPHY FOR MINNESOTAP.O. | | , With the election just **ONE WEEK** away, we need your help more than ever. So what can you do to help? That's what we are here to tell you.

**1.**[**Volunteer for Joe**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=8ad26ef1da&e=5d8d80652b)
Volunteer to send text messages and make phone calls for Joe leading up to the election. It's so important we get out the vote for this election and you can help us do it. Follow this link to sign up and we'll be in touch with phone and text shifts.

**2.** [**Donate to Joe**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=57b5e634a9&e=5d8d80652b)
With a week left, there are still important needs we have on the campaign — and to pay for them, we need resources. Donations have been pouring in to help lift Joe up in the final week and you can join the effort by pitching in today. [**Contribute $5, $20, $50 — any amount helps us win.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=c0802bd79c&e=5d8d80652b)

**3\. Share our message via text, email, & social media**
To energize voters around the state, they need to hear from us. Help us spread the word by sharing our messages on [**Twitter**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=4ca85a56cc&e=5d8d80652b), [**Facebook**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=44b2f33aac&e=5d8d80652b), and [**TikTok**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=a29cf22e0a&e=5d8d80652b). Also please share our latest 2 minute video, [_**"Defending Democracy."**_](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=3fc281690b&e=5d8d80652b)

**4\. Tell your friends and family to vote**
There is nothing that connects with someone more than hearing a personal story from their friend or family member. Tell your friends and family why you think Joe is the right candidate to defeat Ken Paxton this Fall and insist they cast a vote in the runoff election. With your help, we can turn out the voters to win this thing. [**Help them find their polling location here.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=eebb8ed47d&e=5d8d80652b)

**5\. Vote for Joe!**
Finally — vote for Joe! With early voting officially open, find your polling location today and cast your vote for Joe. With your help, we can elect Joe Jaworski and restore ethics and integrity to the Texas Attorney General's office. [**Find your polling location here.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=3aba2e6eae&e=5d8d80652b)
[](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=edeb6098d8&e=5d8d80652b)
It's crunch time and we need our fellow Texans to stand up and pitch in. Whatever you can do over this next week to help Joe win, we thank you.

Together, we can restore ethics and integrity back to the Texas AG's office. **Together, we can elect Joe Jaworski on May 24th. **

Onward!

Team Jaworski

I have major breaking news to share with you, Peter Willis:
**Drafts of the New York State Congressional maps were just released today.** While Westchester and the Bronx would no longer fall within our district, parts of the South Shore would now be included. I have always said that I would fight to represent NY-03 no matter what the district would look like—but Peter Willis, _this new map could change everything._
I was born and raised in the South Shore of Long Island, started my family in Queens, and now raise my family in Nassau. If these maps stand, the new NY-03 Congressional boundaries will reflect the community I’ve spent years organizing in before I ever considered a run for Congress—and I am proud to keep that fight up as we head towards the August 23, 2022 primary.
**Let me be clear:_This is our district to win._ I am the only progressive in this race, the only organizer in this race, and the only grassroots-powered candidate in the race.**

clean_body: | | | | I have major breaking news to share with you, Peter Willis: Drafts of the New York State Congressional maps were just released today. While Westchester and the Bronx would no longer fall within our district, parts of the South Shore would now be included. I have always said that I would fight to represent NY-03 no matter what the district would look like—but Peter Willis, this new map could change everything. I was born and raised in the South Shore of Long Island, started my family in Queens, and now raise my family in Nassau. If these maps stand, the new NY-03 Congressional boundaries will reflect the community I’ve spent years organizing in before I ever considered a run for Congress—and I am proud to keep that fight up as we head towards the August 23, 2022 primary. Let me be clear:This is our district to win. I am the only progressive in this race, the only organizer in this race, and the only grassroots-powered candidate in the race. Already, we have built a powerful coalition of support centering the issues that matter most to our community: Medicare for All, reproductive justice, and an economy and democracy that works for working families, not corporations. | | Dear friend, Minnesota Republicans have picked Scott Jensen to be our candidate for Governor. I wish him well in the endeavor, and encourage everyone to rally around him.
But today I simply want to express incredible gratefulness for the many supporters of my campaign for governor, and the role I played over the years as leader of the Senate. As the legislative session concludes, I am finishing my role in state government and am looking forward to whatever the next chapter of my life may bring. To all those who helped, either openly, or behind the scenes, thank you so much. I have no regrets about running for governor. The thought about the possibility of helping Minnesotans through this role inspired me to step into this arena. I knew my leadership in the Senate was a double-edged sword. On the one hand, being in the arena, making tough decisions, and learning how divided government can still work was a real positive. On the other hand, those same attributes are often considered negative by some, in this case, most delegates. Even so, as I have said, I have no regrets. I’m thankful that many new people have become much more involved in our party. Thank you,
---
---
Paul

**As National Police Week comes to a close, we must remain vigilant in supporting our men and women of law enforcement each and every week.** When I was growing up, it was just normal and commonplace that you showed honor and respect to those in uniform. I can still remember when the attacks on law enforcement started ramping up in earnest about a decade ago. I was a young cop with the Alexandria and later Manassas Park Police Department when the lies and false narratives over the Michael Brown incident ignited hatred towards cops all over and had gasoline poured on it by Barack Obama and Joe Biden. **One of my callings in Congress will be to beat back and shine a spotlight on the false narratives pushed by the Democrat Party and the media related to law enforcement officers.** The facts simply don’t line up with the narratives that have been so corrosive and fomented such division and hatred within our Country. You have my word that as your next member of Congress, I will have the backs of our men and women who put their lives on the line for us every day. ** **
**Endorsed by National ICE Council**
Perhaps no law enforcement agency has been more maligned and lied upon than those who enforce our immigration laws via U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. These are folks who are simply carrying out the laws given to them by our government, yet nearly every single arrest they make is reported negatively by the media and cause for attacks from the Left. In 2020, 90% of those arrested, and 92% of those removed from the Country had criminal convictions or pending criminal charges. This was why I led the fight to prevent Prince William County from becoming a Sanctuary County for criminals here illegally and fought to preserve our vital and life-saving 287(G) agreement with ICE that, by definition, focused on those who had committed a crime against humanity of such consequence that they were booked into our local jail. At the end of the day, most law enforcement officers, whether it’s the cop on the street, a sheriff deputy, or an ICE Officer just want to do their jobs to keep us safe and get back home to their families. The very least we can do is to not make this job even harder on them. I will have the backs of the men and women of law enforcement which is why the National ICE Council has endorsed me in this race. ** **
**Reminder, Early Voting Has Started!** ** **
Just as a reminder, Election Month-and-a-Half has started in the Seventh District. If you prefer not to vote on Election Day, you’ll have ample opportunity to vote between now and June 21st. **[Please click here for a list of voting locations and dates to cast your vote for Team Vega](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=276de930fc4a47349bb5077591971f9b&_e=NXXKgBKb7d8lUDqF46Ts9QsFfOWihS6Xw-72ZjL53yHHs6BiUoz3EQHxslDvcxTE79gU5Hg7TfNkxld4K1ixZ6ztIpmQ2DXgR-2P50StDmUzj8RGIIiySgMyugzPffSepsbLFdg8x0vspdMvy2VIMI9m6KJNdhcfsvzkDpSBGqfJSQsmmy5ERwxqP0ed-DwBOG2ebnqR5894VBH3lR3s1pnK5j1PpFsCeZBvvV7gePXUlev4Llbuy6IM4m9P8NJdlaokS6w91T0mybovLYeAjA%3D%3D).**
**Other Endorsements: Congressman Louie Gohmert and Larry Pratt**
For those of you who watch or listen to Fox News, C-SPAN, or other conservative media, you’ve no doubt seen or heard Congressman Louie Gohmert passionately fighting for and defending our constitutional conservative values. He’s a man of deep faith and personal conviction who’s willing to be unpopular for doing what’s right. That’s why I admire him so much and why I’m thankful to have earned his support and endorsement in this race. # 🚨Make a plan to vote tomorrow!🚨
Friend, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Thank you to everyone who donated to our campaign, knocked on doors, made phone calls, sent texts, talked to a neighbor, and anything else that has helped thusfar in the campaign. Before we get to November, we need to secure the Republican nomination and to do that I humbly ask for your vote tomorrow, May 17th.The past few months has been such a great experience. Our campaign has talked to thousands of voters all across the Lehigh Valley, answered their questions, and shared a vision of a Washington that addresses their concerns. I have immensely enjoyed meeting so many wonderful and fascinating people regardless of their political party and I look forward to doing it with more residents of the Lehigh Valley leading up until the general election, but I need your help to do that. Make sure you have a plan to vote tomorrow and tell others about getting out to vote.Make no mistake, we are at an inflection point in this Country. Inflation is at a 40 year high, gas is at an all time high along with surging energy prices, we are seeing international conflicts escalate, an opioid epidemic which is raging through every town in America, a crisis at our Southern Border, and now a baby formula shortage that is affecting young familes all across the country. I am the best candidate to tackle all of these issues. I don’t want to go down to Washington and be a professional politican and anyone saying that I am is lying right to your face. I have pledged to donate my entire salary to veterans organizations in the district and am the only candidate to term limit their time in Washington. I am ready to win this race in November and bring real, positive change to Washington on behalf of the people of Carbon, Lehigh, Northampton, and Monroe Counties. I would be honored to earn your support tomorrow and I promise to be accountable to only two things if I am elected to Congress, the people of PA-07 and the Constitution of the United States.Thank you for your support and I hope to earn your vote tomorrow.Sincerely, Lisa

Thank you to everyone who donated, knocked on a door, made a phone ca | | | 🚨Make a plan to vote tomorrow!🚨 Friend, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Thank you to everyone who donated to our campaign, knocked on doors, made phone calls, sent texts, talked to a neighbor, and anything else that has helped thusfar in the campaign. Before we get to November, we need to secure the Republican nomination and to do that I humbly ask for your vote tomorrow, May 17th.The past few months has been such a great experience. Our campaign has talked to thousands of voters all across the Lehigh Valley, answered their questions, and shared a vision of a Washington that addresses their concerns. I have immensely enjoyed meeting so many wonderful and fascinating people regardless of their political party and I look forward to doing it with more residents of the Lehigh Valley leading up until the general election, but I need your help to do that. Make sure you have a plan to vote tomorrow and tell others about getting out to vote.Make no mistake, we are at an inflection point in this Country. Inflation is at a 40 year high, gas is at an all time high along with surging energy prices, we are seeing international conflicts escalate, an opioid epidemic which is raging through every town in America, a crisis at our Southern Border, and now a baby formula shortage that is affecting young familes all across the country. I am the best candidate to tackle all of these issues. I don’t want to go down to Washington and be a professional politican and anyone saying that I am is lying right to your face. I have pledged to donate my entire salary to veterans organizations in the district and am the only candidate to term limit their time in Washington. I am ready to win this race in November and bring real, positive change to Washington on behalf of the people of Carbon, Lehigh, Northampton, and Monroe Counties. I would be honored to earn your support tomorrow and I promise to be accountable to only two things if I am elected to Congress, the people of PA-07 and the Constitution of the United States.Thank you for your support and I hope to earn your vote tomorrow.Sincerely, Lisa | | | | Lisa on Fox News! | | | | | | ---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Lisa Scheller for Congress Inc..
